tei:div.tei:p: 197) ༄༅/ bder gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi las byang gzhung srong gi rim pa bzhugs so/ 198)shrī he ru ka gu ru a dwa ya na mo/ bder gshegs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams kun// sgrub pa bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs su// gdod nas lhun grub chen por yongs 'dus pa'i// khyab bdag che mchog pad+ma thod phreng mchod// gang de'i thugs rje'i rol rtsal sgyu 'phrul ni// ye shes dkyil 'khor rnam dgur shar ba la// bsnyen sgrub mchod bstod phrin las gzhung srong gi /las rim gter gzhung ji bzhin 'dir bkod bya//

gu ru rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug gis gter nas spyan drangs pa'i zhi khro bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs 199) rdzogs chen po'i bsnyen sgrub las gzhung gi rim pa ji ltar bya ba ni/ thog mar/ gang du bya ba'i gnas der phyag bdar rkyang nul sogs legs par byas nas/ de nas dbang dang sgrub chen sogs mdun bskyed gtso bor bton pa'i skabs dag tu ni/ de dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bshams bkod rgyas par dgos mod kyang*/ 'dir ni bdag bskyed rkyang sgrub kyi skabs kho na'i dbang du byas phyir/ gtor mchod gang rgyas tsam bshams pa'i tshul bshad par bya ste/ zhi khro bka' brgyad lha tshogs kyi sku rten sogs ji ltar 'byor ba bkram pa'i mdun du cog rtse sogs stegs bzang po lha gos mdzes pas g.yogs pa'i khar me tog sil ma dkram zhing*/ rin chen gyi snod che ba zhig tu che mchog 200) dpal dgu'i gtor ma dpal gtor zur gsum pa 'khor brgyad dang mtheb kyus bskor zhing rgyan dkar dmar gyis mdzes pa steng na dar mthing nag gi gur phub pa gzi brjid dang ldan pa dbus su bzhag de'i g.yas su bla ma'i gtor ma/ g.yon du yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong spyi'i gtor ma dang*/ g.yas kyi mtha' logs su 'di nyid kyi bka' srung dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu'i sger gtor gtso bo zur gsum pa gri ris can che ba gcig la 'khor zur sum cus bskor ba sha khrag gi rgyan pa bzhag g.yon gyi mtha' 'gram du dpal gyi bka' sdod rnams kyi gtor ma yang snga ma ltar/ gtso bo ni zur gsum gri ras can de khams gsum hūm̐ sgra can zhes khyung gi gtor ma yin la/ de'i 'khor ni lha grangs mang bas grangs mnyam pa ni mi 'grub kyang ji tsam shong shong gis bskor zhing sha khrag gis brgyan pa bzhag de dag gi g.yas g.yon du ka pā lar bdud rtsi sman rag spyi ltar dang*/ 'di la khyad par du bdud rtsi bsangs nan zhes pa/

rin chen gyi snod ci rigs par dzā gad chang phud bzang pos bkang ba zhig kyang gtso gtor gyi mdun du bzhag cing*/ gzhan yang phyi nang gsang mchod spyan 201) gzigs 'dod yon phun sum pa'i mchod rdzas dang bkod pa'i khyad par mdzes shing brjid la bag dro ba bsgrub pa po rnams snang ba 'gyur thub pa'i bsham bkod dang*/ spos dang rol mo'i bye brag sogs mdor na rtsa gsum zhi khro dam can gyi tshogs thams cad mnyes shing dam la 'du ba'i rten 'brel gyi gnad yod pas/ g.yas med khyer bde sgyid ngan gyi dbang du mi btang bar/ gtor tshogs mar me mchod rdzas yo byad la 'bags rtsogs dang ser sna sogs skyon gyis bslad na/ ye shes lha la rtog pa'i 'dzin pa dang bral yang bka' srung dam can rnams ni legs nyes phra mo la'ang mgu khang byed cing*/ de'i phan gnod kyi 'bras bu sgrub pa po la 'phral du 'byung phyir/ rtsings chos su ma song bar bya dgos pa ni gsang sngags kyi dam tshig sgo dang po yin no/ de nas cho ga dngos la 'jug pa'i dang por/ skyabs sems tshogs gsog sdom gzung rnams kyi rang rgyud las rung du ma sgrubs na gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam la 'jug par mi dbang bas de dag bya ba ni/ phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa'i zhing khams na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams la mos gus gdung shugs 202) kyi 'dun pa bskyed cing*/ ji skad du/ ye shes lha la rang rgyud kyi// rtsis gdab khrigs su bcad pa med// gang ltar mos pa de bzhin snang*// zhes gsungs pa bzhin mos pa'i rang gzugs ji ltar 'dod bzhin 'char ba yin phyir/ 'di skabs su phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ma lus sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs 'ba' shig pa'i rnam 'gyur gyi zhing khams kyi khyad par bzhugs par mos la tshig gi rjes su don sems la dran pa'i ngang nas 'di skad du/ na mo/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rab 'byams gzhal yas nas// bla med dkon mchog rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs// bdag sogs mtha' yas sems can ma lus kun// dus 'di nas bzung sangs rgyas ma thob par// thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro la dgongs mdzad pa'i// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// rtse gcig thugs rjes byin rlabs ye shes sku// yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// rtsol rtog mi mnga' yon tan thugs rje'i bdag

/sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal = chags pa med par 'gro don ma lus 'byung*/ 203) dam can rnams la phyag 'tshal = ma nor laṃ la gnas mdzad zhing mchog skyong*// dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal = 'gro ba'i don du rang byung sku sprul ba// pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la phyag 'tshal = gcig shes kun grol skad cig sangs rgyas ston// 'gro mgon chos dbang sku la = ji bzhin rtogs pa'i gdengs ldan thugs rje'i bdag /rgyal sras sman lung pa la = mthar phyin nges pa'i don ston mkhyen brtse'i sku// sangs rgyas dwags ston sku la = bka' lung dbang bsgyur mthar phyin nges don bdag badz+ra dz+nya na'i sku la = gsang sngags rgyud 'dzin lung rig kun gyi bdag bu d+dha shrī'i sku la = sngon gyi las pa gu rus byin brlabs pa// gu ṇa pha la'i sku la = u rgyan lung bstan chos dbang thugs kyi sras// chos sku 'od zer sku la = rang sems chos skur rtogs nas gzhan 204) don mdzad// ye shes kun dga'i sku la phyag 'tshal = bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'dzin// dpal 'byor dbang phyug sku la = mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung la mnga' brnyes pa// nam mkha' gu ru'i sku la = sngags kyi rab 'byams bslabs gsum rgyan gyis mdzes// bsod nams rab rgyal sku la = rgyal bas byin rlabs lung rigs kun gyi bdag o rgyan bstan 'dzin sku la = legs nges stangs 'dzin dngos grub ster mdzad pa// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal = sangs rgyas bstan bsrung bka' yi bya ra mdzad// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ yo ga sa ma ya dzaḥ yo ga sa ma ya hūm̐/ kro dha sa ma ya dzaḥ kro d+dha sa ma ya hūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ bdag gzhan 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste snying po sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ 205) drin can rtsa ba dang rgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi'o/ dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ sangs rgyas la = chos la = dge 'dun la = bla ma la = sangs rgyas la = chos la = dge 'dun la = yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la = mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams la = dam pa ye shes kyi chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang sdan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la gnas par gyur cig oṃ/ bder bshegs yongs 206) rdzogs rgyal ba zhi khro'i ngang*/ chos sku spros bral bde chen gdod nas dag longs spyod rdzogs sku bsam 'das brjod las 'das// sprul sku 'gro don rdzogs mdzad bdag la dgongs// kun tu bzang po che mchog he ru ka// 'gro 'dul thabs kyi gtso brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ yon tan sku gsung thugs dang phrin las bdag 'dod 'jo'o kun mdzod khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ/ dpal ldan zhi khro dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag /phyi nang gsang ba de nyid mchod pa'i sprin// sku gsung thugs mchog nam mkha'i gter mdzod kyi// bla med mchod sprin mchog sbyar mchod pa bzhes// oṃ/ thog med dus nas 'khor 'das bdag gzhan don// gnyis med byang chub sems su gcig nyid kyang*// las kyis 'khrul pas tha dad so sor bzung*// gnyis 'dzin log rtog yid kyis the tshom byung*// ma rig bag la nyal 207) ba'i rnam smin gyis// rgyal ba'i dgongs spyod zab mo'i gting ma rtogs// thabs dang shes rab ya bral blang dor spyad// che mchog gsang ba'i bka' las 'gal zhing nyams// 'bras bu don chen sgrub pa'i rgyur 'gyur pa// gnong 'gyod zhi ba'i sems kyis rab sbyang zhing*// rtsa ba yan lag sku gsung thugs kyi gsang*// thun mong mchog dang bye brag bsam mi khyab// ji ltar gdams pa gzhung bzhin ma 'gyis pa// bder gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro 'khor dag bcas// thugs rje mnga' bdag khyed la bzod gsol bshags//

oṃ/ ye shes rtsal gyis sangs rgyas sa non cing*// thugs rje'i shugs kyis gang 'dul 'gro don mdzad// dus gsum mi 'bral kun tu dgongs mdzod la// dag tshangs mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ/ zhi khro rgyal ba ye shes sku// 'gro la phan mdzad 208) thugs rje can// srid pa gsum gyi gnyen gcig bu// lha yi lha rnams dgongs su gsol// bde bar gshegs pa kun 'dus pa// sprul pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas// phyogs dus kun tu bzhugs pa rnams// ma lus 'dus pa mkhyen par gsol// bdag ni rgyal srid longs spyod dang*// rang don ched du mi sgrub cing*// 'gro gzhan don du 'bad brtson nas// kun gyi dpal du 'gyur bar bya// kun mkhyen ye shes spyan sdan pas// bdag gzhan kun gyi lhag bsam mkhyen/ /spyan sngar bdag gis dam bcas pa// rnal 'byor bslu bar mi bgyi'o// khe dang grags pa 'jig rten chos// g.yo sgyu ngan pa'i sems spangs nas// kun tu bzang po byang chub sems// don dam kun rdzob tshul bzung ngo*// sems can thams cad 'dus gyur to// bdag la gnod par rab sbyang kyang*// shes rab snying rje dang 'bral bas// yi dam lha dang bla ma dang*// mchod bzung theg 209) pa cher gnas pa// srog gi phyir yang mi gtong sgrubs// snang srid rmi lam sgyu ma la// 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa ma mchis pas// skye bo gzhan gyi don 'gyur na// byang chub sems kyi spyod pa yis// rang dbang du ni skye ba blang*// bdag ni gcig pu zhi bde la// myur 'gro'i spro ba ma mchis par// ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs par// bskal pa rgya mtshor mi gtong zhing*// byang chub sems kyi dga' bas kyang*// shes rab thabs kyi don mdzad tshe// 'gro ba las kyi 'dul skal la// so so'i blo dang skad bzhin du// ji ltar 'tshams pa de ston no// rnal 'byor mchog gi lam zhugs te// skyes chen rig pa 'dzin pa dag

/nus pa ji snyed shugs kyis ni// brtson 'grus 'dab pas bsnyen bskur ro// gsang ba'i theg pa bla med la// rab sdang gdug pa'i tshul 210) 'chang ba// nus mthu drag rtsal ci yod kyis// myur du sgrol bar drag brtsam mo// da lta'i dus chen 'di nyid nas// theg chen bla med thug kyi bar// dpal chen bde bar gshegs rnams kyis// ji ltar dam bcas de bzung ngo*/ /de ltar 'di yan chad rnams thun mong gi sngon 'gro yin la/ de nas las gzhung nyid la thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum gyi sa bcad rtsa tho gu ru rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid kyis mdzad pa las/ ༈ zhi khro gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi// sgrub chen las gzhung bsrang ba la// sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum/ sngon 'gro thun mong las bdun ni/ mtshams bcad/ brda sgo brda phyag 'tshal/ dam bca'/ byin dbab/ mchod/ bshags bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i dang por mtshams gcod kyi sngon du bdag nyid lha'i ting 'dzin bsgom nas bar gcod kyi bgegs bskrad pa 'di bzhin tshig don mthun par bya ste/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na swa bhā ād+ma konyaham̐/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis 211) bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis ram̐ las bskal pa'i me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong na/ bdag nyid skad cig gis che mchog he ru ka dbu gsum pa phyag drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa sku mdog mthing nag rab tu 'bar ba/ g.yas zhal dkar la 'tsher ba/ g.yon zhal dmar la gshe ba/ dbus zhal mthing la rngams pa/ spyan g.yas gsum gyen du gzigs pa/ g.yaun gsum thur du gzigs pa/ dbus gsum thad kar gdangs mig tu bgrad pa/ zhal bgrad pa ljags 'dril ba mche ba gtsigs pa/ smin ma ag tshom ral pa khaṃ nag mun ltar gtibs pa/ snyan drug gsangs la ma 'gags par gsal ba/ zhal gsum nas phaṭa sgra sgrog pa/ shangs gsum nas hūm̐ sgra 'byin pa/

at+pal nyi ma zla bas snyan gong 212) brgyan pa/ klu rigs lnga sbrul gyi rnam pas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ bar pa na rtse lnga pa/ mtha' ma na rtse gsum pa bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na ban+dha lcang lo can khrag gis bkang ba/ bar pa na thod rlon khrag gis bkang ba/ mtha' ma na thod skam khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ g.yas dang po'i rdo rje g.yas dang po'i rdo rje g.yon dang po'i ban dmar dkrug pa'i tshul gyis yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum dor stabs su bgrad pa/ gsang bkab dar sna lnga dang sta zur dar dpyangs gsum gyis brgyan pa/ sku stod la glang chen gyi ko rlon dang mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gsol ba/ sku smad la stag lpags kyi sham thabs dkris pa/ thod pa skam po lnga yis dbu la brgyan cing thod rlon lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ thal chen zhag chen dmar chen gsum gyis zhal gyis 'bur bzhi dang sku sul thams cad brgyan pa/ 213) rdo rje'i gshog pa g.yas su gdengs pa/ rin po che'i gshog pa g.yon du gdengs pa/ dpungs pa g.yas g.yon gnyis na ye shes kyi khyung dkar nag re re lding ba/ dbu skra dang ba spu thams cad khro chung dang mtshon cha'i rnam par 'phro ba rdo rje'i slag pa/ dbang gi bse khrab/ dpal gyi chas bcu/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad/ gar gyi nyams dgu rus pa'i rgyan drug he ru ka'i rngams brjid dang ldan pa/ de'i pang du yum gnam zhal kun tu bzang mo sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wām̐ ga yab la 'khyud cing g.yon pa dung dmar gtso la stob pa/ zhabs g.yas phab kyi sked la 'khril zhing g.yon brkyang ba/ gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang dur khrod rus pa'i dra bas brgyan pa/ yab yum gnyis su med par bskal pa'i me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong 214) na bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las/ shar du thugs las sprul te badz+ra he ru ka 'phros/ lhor sku las sprul te gshin rje'i gshed po/

nub tu gsung las sprul te rta mgrin dbang chen/ byang du phrin las sprul te rdo rje gzhon nu/ shar lhor gzi brjid las sprul te bla med he ru ka/ lho nub tu rigs las sprul te rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal/ nub byang du 'jigs byed las sprul te dregs pa kun 'dul/ byang shar du stobs las sprul te stobs ldan nag po 'phros/ de'i steng gi phyogs su khro bo chen po hūm̐ ka ra/ shar du rnam par rgyal ba/ lhor gshin rje gshed po/ nub tu rta mgrin rgyal po/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ shar lhor dbyug pa sngon po/ lho nub tu mi g.yo mgon po/ nub byang du 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ byang shar du khams gsum rnam rgyal/ 'og tu stobs 215) po che/ de thams cad kyi sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul gsum sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs shing zhal nas hūm̐ sgra 'byin par rol pa khro bo chen po'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ lha tshogs de dag thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/

chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi = gsang sngags dang rigs sngags dang gzugs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po de rnams kyi mthu dang nus pa byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas/ gnod byed log 'dren bar chad 'byung po/ mi min mi ru brdzu ba/ lha min lha ru brdzu ba/ 216) gang dag tshe dang srog la bar du gcod pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdangs 'phrog pa/ bdud rtsi'i bcud 'phrog pa/ gtor ma'i ro 'phrog pa/ rak+ta'i zhag 'phrog pa/ bdug spos kyi dri 'phrog pa/ me tog gi mdangs 'phrog pa/ mar me'i 'od 'phrog pa/ dri chab kyi bsung 'phrog pa/ zhal zas kyi gzugs 'phrog pa/ rol mo'i sgra gcog pa/ rnal 'byor pa'i drod la myul zhing sgrub pa po la bar du gcod pa thams cad gnas 'dir ma 'dug par gzhan la phar byer zhig deng zhig song zhig sarba bhū ta uts+tsha ṭa ya phaṭaḥ zhes rol mo'i sgra drag po dang ting 'dzin gsal bas bgegs bskrad do/ slar yang las gzhung nyid kyi mtshams gcod la rim pa gsum yod pa'i dang po rang bzhin lta ba'i gdengs kyis bgegs skrod pa ni/ bdag nyid dpal chen po'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gsal ba'i ngang nas/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba zhi khro yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du// snang srid rnam dag ye shes lha yi tshogs// kun bzang chos 217) kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// rig rtsal rnam dag thabs shes g.yung drung lha// 'di la log par lta ba'i dgra dag bgegs// bdud sde dpung bcas thams cad phyir dengs shig oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐/ gṛ h+na pā ya gṛ ha na pā ya hūm̐/ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wā na/ badz+ra bid+ya rā dzā hūm̐ phaṭaḥ gnyis pa drag po mtshon cha'i mtshams kyi bsrung ba ni/ bdag nyid dpal kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer gyi mtshon cha sna tshogs bu yug 'tshub pa bzhin 'phros pas gur khang du gyur par dmigs la/

hūm̐/ bdag nyid dpal chen khrag 'thung thugs ka nas// drag po'i byin rlabs mtshon cha'i 'od zer 'phro// mtshon cha'i gur chen ye shes me dpung 'bar// phyogs mtshams steng 'og kun tu khyab par bsrung*// oṃbadz+ra tsakra tīkaṣaṇa karma kī la yaḥ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ gsum pa khro bo rol 218) mtshams kyi tshar bcad pa ni/ slar yang bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sprul pa'i khro tshogs mthing nag rab 'jigs grangs med 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rigs thams cad bsgral te rnam shes chos dbyings su spar zhing gzugs phung gdan du bting ba'i khar bzhugs nas bar chad bsrung bar bsam la/ hūm̐/ dregs pa lha chen phyogs skyong bsnol ba'i steng*// che mchog la sogs dpal chen khro rgyal tshogs/ gar dgu'i tshul gyis hūm̐ sgra sgrog cing bzhugs// bar chad 'byung po thams cad rdul du rlog oṃ badz+ra kro d+dha swa bhā wa sa ma ya ru lu ru lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bi shwa badz+ra tsakra dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐/ phyogs mtshams kun tu rdo rje'i me// rnam par 'phro ba rab bsam ste// ma rungs pa dag tshig byas nas// phyogs bcu rab tu 'phro bar gyur// phyogs mtshams phur bus gdab nas kyang*// steng 'og yan lag byin gyis rlobs// badz+ra badz+ra badz+ra ram̐ yam̐ kham̐*/ 219) sngon 'gro'i las rim gnyis pa brda sgo dbye ba ni/ snod dang bcud gzhal yas khang dang lha'i rang bzhin ye nas yin pa'i tshul dran par byas te/ hūm̐/ snang srid thams cad bde chen gzhal yas khang*// gzugs snang thams cad rang rig ye shes lha// de nyid ma rtogs ma rig sgo bcad pas/ rang gsal ye shes 'char sgo da phyes shig bh+rum̐ pra be sha ya phaṭaḥ gsum pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ snod bcud lha'i dkyil 'khor de thams cad kyang rang sems las gzhan su ma yin par rang ngo shes pa'i phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ rang byung ye shes snying po sems kyi lha// ma rtogs rang ngo rang gis ma shes pas// ye nas rang dang 'grogs kyang zhal ma mjal// rang gsal brda yi don dang mjal phyag 'tshal/

hūm̐ he ru ka/ a ti pu ho/ pra tī ts+tsha ho/ bzhi pa lha dngami 'bral bar dam bca' ba ni/ lha dang rang sems dbyer med yin par sngon chad ma rig pa de da lta rtogs pa 'di las mi 'da' zhing mi gtong bar zhes dam bcas zhing*/ hūm̐/ dus gsum 220) bder gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs// bskal pa sngon 'das dus nas yi dam lha// da lta gnyis med don dam rang ngo shes// srog gi phyir yang mi btang bsgrub lags so// hūm̐ badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ya hūm̐/ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya hūm̐/ lnga pa byin dbab ni/ bdag gi thugs srog hūm̐ las dad pa'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu grangs med pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs dam rgyud bskul te sangs rgyas ma lus rgyal ba zhi khro yongs rdzogs kyi lha'i rnam par byon nas bdag la dbang bskur/ gnas khang yo byad dkyil 'khor mchod rdzas thams cad la byin gyis brlabs par mdzad cing bdag dang snod bcud thams cad ye shes chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur par mos la/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings ye shes lnga'i pho brang nas// chos sku skye med dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// longs sku rigs lnga zhi khro 'khor dang bcas// sprul sku yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams// thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// sku gsung thugs kyi byin 221) gyis brlab tu gsol// ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di la byin cig phab// khyed kyis thugs rjes mchog gis bzung du gsol// oṃ shrī badz+ra kro dha he wa de wa sarba duṣ+ṭan ḍā ki nī sa ma ya ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ ā we sha ya a āḥ drug pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs rgyas par spro na sangs rgyas dwags ston pas mdzad pa'i lhan thabs sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin dang*/ bsdus pa ni gong gi byin 'bebs des snod bcud ma lus byin gyis brlabs pa yin phyir des chog cing*/

'bul tshig ni/ mchod bya dang mchod byed gnyis med du shes pa'i ngang nas hūm̐/ rang dang gnyis med lha tshogs la// mar me sman gtor rak+ta dang*/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin gtibs/ thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul gyi bzhes// oṃ ā hūm̐/ badz+ra dhu pe hūm̐ 222) badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐/ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ badz+ra shab+ta hūm̐/ badz+ra sarba pu dza me gha hūm̐/ des ni phyi mchod rnams byin gyis brlabs cing phul nas/ nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta byin brlabs yang*// rgyas par spro na gzhan nas byung ba ltar dang*/ bsdu na gter gzhung nyid kyi sngags kyis byin rlabs 'di ltas 'grub ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥthā/ zhes lan bdun nam gsum gyis rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par mos*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba lin+ta te dzo ba lin+ta ba la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ye swā hā/ zhes bzlas pas dam rdzasagator ma 'dod yon phun tshogs nam mkha' dang mnyam par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes bzlas pa tsam gyis rak+ta'i rgya mtsho stong gsum gang bar gyur par bsam mo/ gsum pa phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa thams cad byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza/ ma hā pañtsa/ ma hā ba lin+ta/ ma hā rak+ta/ 223) a ho su kha sa ma ye swā hā/ zhes brjod pas mchod pa'i rdzas dang dngos por gyur tshad thams cad rgya nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam zhing rgyun 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du zad pa med cing yongs su 'phel bas/ mchod yul thams cad kyi thugs rgyud la zag med kyi bde ba khyad par can bskyed nus par bsam mo/ ༈ bdun pa bshags pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs las sprul pa'i rtsa gsum zhi khro'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar gang bar bzhugs par mos la/ hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad dgongs// bskal ba sngon nas da lta'i dus yan chad// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chags sogs// rang gnong 'gyod sems drag pos mthol zhingabashags// oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ ra ra ka/ pre ta ka/ tit+ya ka/ ni be sha/ de wa a li bi shud+dhe/ dkaṣa shud+dhe shud+dhe swā hā/ zhes bshags pas sdig sgrib thams cad gzhi med du byang zhing dag nas/ mdun gyi bshags yul thams cad kyang rang nyid la 224) thim ma thag rang nyid lha tshogs su snang ba thams cad kyang re shig la sprin nam mkha' la yal ba bzhin chos dbyings stong pa chen por yal bar bsam mo/ de ltar 'di yan chad kyis sngon 'gro'i las rim bdun po grub pa'o/ ༈ de nas dngos gzhi'i las rim skor lnga ni/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum 'byung rim brtsegs pa// gzhal yas lha bskyed byin rlabs bskur// rang bzhin spyan drangs brtan par bzhugs// phyag dang phyag rgya glus mchod cing*// phyi dang nang dang gsang mchod 'bul// dug gsum sman gtor rak+ta dang*// bdud rtsi bsang nan sbyor sgrol mchod// bstod bshags 'dzab bzlas dngos grub blang*// zhes gsungs pa'i dngos por ting 'dzin rnam pa gsum gyi thog mar de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang sems gdod ma'i gnas lugs nyid las ma g.yos pa'i don la mnyam par gzhag ste/ hūm̐/ spros med yang dag de bzhin nyid// mnyam yangs phyogs bral kun tu gdal// ma nor ma bcos chos kyi sku// 225) rang bzhin lhun grub ngang gis gsal// oṃ ma hā shun+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa at+ma konyahaṃ/ gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ de lta bu'i rang sems chos sku'i rang zhal ma mthong ba'i sems can bdag med la bdag tu 'dzin zhing dngos med la dngos por bzung bas 'khor ma mtha' med du 'khyams pa rnams la stong nyid kyi rtsal mdangs snying rje phyogs med du bsgom zhing*/ hūm̐/ de bzhin kun khyab kun tu snang*// ma rig 'khrul snang 'khor ba'i klong*// gzung 'dzin bag chags rab tu 'thas/ ma rtogs sems can snying re rje// oṃ dharma dhā tu pya bhā wa bi shud+dhe maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/

gsum pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ rang sems stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi ngo bo de nyid sems can gyi don rgya cher bya ba'i phyir/ sprul pa thams cad spro ba'i gzhi'am rang rgyu rang rig yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag 'od 'bar ba gcig tu gyur pa chos dbyings nam mkha'i thongs su zla ba ltar lding bar dmigs la/ hūm̐/ chos rnams rang byung rten 'brel te// rgyu las ma byung gang yang 226) med// hūm̐ ni thams cad skyed pa'i rgyu// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i yi ge bsgom// tsat+ta badz+ra sa mā dhi hūm̐/ bzhi pa 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni/ rang rig rgyu'i yi ge hūm̐ las ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gsum 'phros pa las/ me rlung chu gsum gyi skal pa byung ste ma dag 'jig rten gyi snod bcud thams cad bsreg gtor bkrus nas nam mkha' stong pa mtha' dbus bral bar gyur pa las/ slar yang rgyu'i yi ge hūm̐ las yum lnga'i rang bzhin 'byung ba rnams kyi sa bon rnams 'phro bar bsam ste/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ hūm̐/ bskal pa gsum gyi 'jig rten stongs// ye nas dag pa'i ngang nyid las// snod bcud sbyang phyir 'byung rim brtsegs// rnam dag yum lnga'i mkha' klong gsal/ hūm̐ e yam̐ ra sum̐ keṃ ram̐ bh+rum̐/ hūm̐/ e las nam mkha' mtha' dbus med// yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor steng*// ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil// sum̐ las zhing chen sa gzhi gdal// keṃ las rus pa'i ri rab steng*// ram̐ las bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar// 227) lnga pa gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa skyed pa ni/ rgyu'i yi ge hūm̐ las bh+rum̐ kha dog lnga ldan 'phros pa gnas 'gyur ba las gzhal yas khang du gyur te/ phyi pho brang chen po gcig la nang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dgu dang ldan pa'i phyi rol 'khor yug tu dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor zhing*/ de'i phyi rol tu pad+ma 'dab stong kha gyen du lta ba dang*/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong steng nas mar phubs pa'i mtha' skor rdo rje'i brag ris bskor ba'i phyi nas ye shes kyi me'i ra gur steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu 'bar ba/

de'i phyi rol 'og gzhi keṃ rus kyi ri rab steng gi zur bzhir gter gyi bum pa ri bo tsam bzhi'i kha rgyan dpag bsam gyi shing lo me tog 'bras bur 'dzom pas nam mkha' khyab ste/ 'di dag gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor gzhan las ma bshad kyang sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi khyad chos yin no/ gdan bskyed pa la yang*/ pho brang gi gling dgu re re bzhin du nang gi dbus su gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu 'khyud dang bcas pa re re dang*/ pho brang dbus ma gtso mchog gi gnas su 'khor lo'i lte ba zla gam 228) sgo gcig pa/ de'i nang du chos 'byung mthing nag gru gsum gyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba nyi ma rnams brtsegs pa'i khar/ dregs pa'i gdan ni/ khyab 'jug dbang phyug dbang po/ tshogs bdag bh+riṅgi ri ri/ dga' byed dbang phyug kartī ka ste lha chen brgyad/ mtha' yas/ dung khyong*/ 'jog po/ pad chen/ stobs rgyu/ rigs ldan/ hu lan+ta/ ba su ka ste klu chen brgyad po rnams bsnol ba'i khar/ byol song gtso bo brgyad ni/ mi 'jigs seng ge dpal ba stag rngams pa gzig gtum pa dom/ stobs glang po che/ brjid pa ma he/ 'jigs pa chu srin/ gdug pa sbrul dang brgyad kyis gnon pa/ de dag gi steng du gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa bting ba'i khar/ 'khor ba'i rgyu chags sdang gnyis kyi rang gzugs dregs pa thams cad kyi gtso bo dbang phyug dang u ma gnyis kha spub dag gan rgyal du bsgyel ba'i gdan dang*/ phyogs mtshams kyi gtso bo brgyad la pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du/ shar du ru dra pho mo bsnol ba lhor chung glang zung bzhi/ nub tu klu rgyal pho mo/ byang du lha chen pho mo/ shar lhor srid pa'i pho mo bsnol 229) ba lho nub tu dar zab sna lnga'i 'bol stan/ nub byang du 'jig rten dregs pa bsnol ba/ byang shar du dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan gyis mtshan pa/ rtsibs bzhi re re la yang pad+ma nyi zla dgra bgegs kyi gdan dang*/

sgo ba rnams la bam ro'i gdan re dang bcas pa bskyed do/ hūm̐/ bh+rum̐ las rin chen gzhal yas khang*// dur khrod rab 'jigs dkyil 'khor bskyed// zla gam ye shes 'char sgo'i dbus// chos sku 'gyur med e ru gsal// bhañdza skam rlon pho brang brtsigs// rin chen mdzes pa'i dkyil 'khor dbus// 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu 'khyud bcas// gru chad bar 'khyam sgo 'khyud rdzogs// rang byung lhun grub ngo mtshar rtse// dregs pa pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan// gtso dang 'khor la 'tsham par bsam// bh+rum̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe/ bhañdza dz+nyā na e tsakra maṇ+ḍa la bh+rum̐/ ru dra kro dhi ti ra bam/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+t+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ ༈ drug pa lha bskyed pa ni/ de ltar 'byung rim gzhal yas gdan dang bcas pa gsal 230) ba'i ngang nas/ rang sems rgyu'i yi ge hūm̐ de nyid bya chen bzlas pa la babs pa ltar nam mkha' dbyings nas pho brang dbus ma'i gdan gyi steng du babs te/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad la mchod pa 'bul/ 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sdug bsngal sbyangs/ bstan pa'i ru dra gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ 'od zer tshur 'dus nas hūm̐ la thim pa tsam gyis gnas 'gyur te/ bdag gi gtso mchog yab yum du gsal bar bya ba 'di ni cho ga gsum bskyed kyi sgom tshul yin la/ rgyas par mngon byang lnga bskyed kyi lugs su byed na/ hūm̐ yig des 'od zer spro bsdu don gnyis byas nas 'od zer tshur bsdus hūm̐ la thim ma thag rdo rje mthing nag rtse dgu pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis gong bzhin byas nas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gtso mchog skur gsal ba'o/

hūm̐/ rgyu yi yi ge gdan la babs// spro bsdu'i sbyor bas dpal chen sku// bdag nyid che mchog he ru ka// mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa// zhabs bzhi gyad kyi dor thabs bgrad// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal// rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog hūm̐// spyan dgu zhal bgrad mche ba btsigs// g.yas kyi phyag gsum rdo rje gsor// g.yon gyi phyag gsum bhan dmar 'dzin// dur khrod 'jigs pa'i chas kyis brgyan// gnam zhal yum chen kun bzang 'khril// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing*// g.yas pa gtsor 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams// g.yon pa dung dmar gtso la stob// yab yum sbyor ba'i byin rlabs las// rigs bzhi lha tshogs 'khor bcas gsal// bskal pa'i me dpung klong na bzhugs// oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ma hā kro dhi shwa ri s+t+wa/ de nas yab yum kyi mkha' gsang byin brlabs shing thabs shes bde sbyor gyi byang chub sems las sras 'khor spro ba ni/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ badz+ra oṃ/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la e aṃ/ sa ma 232) ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+wa/ ra ho haṃ/ rā ga ya mi/ sa ma ya mu dra pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ de ltar yab yam sbyor bas byang sems yum gyi pad+ma nas yab kyi gsang ba'i lam du yar log pa hūm̐ mthing nag nyis 'brel brgyad du gyur pa rnams gtso bo'i thugs ka nas phyir 'phros te phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi gdan thog tu babs gnas gyur bas lha so so'i skur gyur par bsam la/ hūm̐/ dpal chen yab yum thugs ka nas// phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du// mthing nag hūm̐ chen yig 'bru spro/ khrag 'thung yab yum sras bcas bskyed// hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐/ shar du badz+ra he ru ka// badz+ra kri dhi shwa ri yum// rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas la//

oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐/ lho ru 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// 233) za byed bai tra nag mo yum// rigs bzhi la sogs/ oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐/ nub tu dbang chen rta mchog dpal// pad+ma gzi ldan khro mo yum/ rigs bzhi = oṃ pad+ma ta kṛ ma hā kro dha ha ya gṝ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐/ byang du rdo rje gzhon nu che// 'khor lo rgyas 'debs dpal gyi yum// rigs bzhi = ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ sarba big+nan bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐/ shar lhor bla med he ru ka// kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐/ lho nub rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal// rdo rje rnal 'byor gsang ba'i yum// rigs bzhi = oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐/ nub byang dregs pa kun 'dul che// khams gsum srid pa'i spyi 'dul yum// 234) rigs bzhi = oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan phaṭaḥ hūm̐/ byang shar stobs ldan nag po che// 'byung ba lnga yi bdag mo yum// rigs bzhi = oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan e dza bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐/ nyi ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin// dpal chen so so'i sprul 'khor bcas// phyi rol sgo ba rigs bzhi ni// ya man pradz+nya pad+ma big lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril// tshom bu dgu yi lha tshogs rnams// sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs// ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs par gsal// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ hūm̐/ phyi rol lcags ri 'khor yug la// mkha' 'gro dbang phyug ging laṅga*/ 'bar ma ma sring bka' sdod tshogs// bsam gyis mi khyab yongs rdzogs gtibs// ma hā mu dra sa ma ya ho/ ༈ de ltar pho brang gling dgu re re bzhin du gtso bo yab yum gyi phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi yab yum dang*/ lhag ma thams cad rang rang bar 'khyams su bzhugs shing*/ sgo bzhir rang rang gi sgo ba rnams dang bcas 235) yongs bsdom gyi lha grangs ni/ che mchog yon tan gyi lha tshogs sum cu so gnyis/

yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ 'jam dpal sku'i lha tshogs lnga bcu rtsa dgu pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs dgu bcu rtsa brgyad/ phur pa phrin las bdun bcu rtsa bzhi/ ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs bdun cu don dgu rig 'dzin slob dpon lha tshogs nyi shu rtsa drug 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi lha tshogs bzhi bcu tham pa/ dmod pa drag sngags kyi lha tshogs nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ dpal gyi bka' sdod kyi lha tshogs nyis brgya dang so drug rnams bsdom pas bdun brgya nyer lngar bsdus pa yin na'ang*/ nang tshan du phyes na/ 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma 'bum tsho nyi shu yod kyang 'dir 'di dag gi gtso mo nyi shu la bsdus nas bgrangs pa yin no/ de ltar lha tshogs thams cad kyang ngo bo gcig la rnam 'gyur tha dad pa'i gtso bo so so'i 'khor thams cad kyang nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi tshul ltar rang byung lhun grub tu gsal ba'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad dmar 'dab brgyad kyi ze'u 'brur āḥdamar po/ thugs kar rdo rje rgya gram mthing ga'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gis mtshan pa re re bsgom par bya'o/ 236) ༈ bdun pa dbang bskur ba ni/ lha thams cad kyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros 'og min chos kyi dbyings nas rgyal ba kun bzang rigs lnga yab yum la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas nyi zer gyi rdul bzhin byon nas bdag dam tshig 'khor bcas rnams la sku gsung thugs ye shes lnga'i dbang bskur bar mos la/ rang byung dkyil 'khor dpal chen tshogs// ye shes rnam lnga'i dbang bskur cig /oṃ ā hūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hriḥha oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wak+tsit+ta dz+nyā na pañtsa badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma konyahaṃ/ zhes dbang bskur ba'i dbang rtags su lha thams cad kyi dbu'i gtsug tu kun bzang dang*/ gzhan rgyal ba rigs lnga rnams lha so so'i rigs mthun gyis gtso bo mdzad pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan pa'o/

brgyad pa ye shes pa spyan drangs pa ni/ lha gtso 'khor rang rang so so'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 237) tshad med bzhi'i lha mo grangs med pa 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas na ye shes sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ chos sku las gzugs skur bzhengs te nam mkha'i khams khengs par byon pa'i mos pa dang dad gdung bskyed la/ hūm̐/ rnam dag chos dbyings mnyam nyid las// zhi khro yongs rdzogs sku bzhengs la// srid gsum gdug pa'i tshogs bsgral phyir// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye he dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ sa ma ya hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥ dgu pa bzhugs gsol ni/ de lta bu'i lha tshogs thams cad ye nas rang rig ye shes su dbyer med kyang*/ rnam pa sgyu ma tsam du/ gtso bo la gtso bo/ 'khor la 'khor gnyis med du thim par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐/ bder bshegs kun 'dus dkyil 'khor 'dir// dam tshig ye shes dbyer med par// chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin du// du maro gcig brtan par bzhugs// sa ma ya a we sha ya tiṣ+ṭha s+t+wa/ dgu pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ 238) bdag nyid kyi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha tshogs bzhi la rang 'dra'i 'khor tshogs grangs med pas bskor ba 'phros pas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi nas phyag bams gyis mi khyab pa btsal nas slar rang gi thugs kar thim par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐/ chos rnams rang bzhin ye nas dag rtog 'khrul 'jig rten sems can la// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las ston// dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pu ho/ na maḥhri/ slar yang phyag 'tshal rgyas par spro na chos bka' 'di nyid ba rag bshags skongs nas gsungs pa'i phyag 'tshal yang skabs 'dir drangs te/ na mo/ yon tan phun tshogs bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dmigs med spros bral chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo// bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro mgon spyir yang sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal sku la =

gnas lugs mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la = yang dag mngon par byang chub sku la = nyon mongs zhi byed zhi ba'i lha la = log lta tshar gcod khro bo'i tshogs la = thabs mgon tshe bdag 'jam dpal 239) sku la phyag 'tshal lo// skyon bral sgra sgrog pad+ma gsung la = yang dag don rtogs badz+ra thugs la = dug lnga'i nad sel bdud rtsi sman la = dregs pa 'joms mdzad phur pa'i tshogs la = 'byung ba'i mnga' bdag ma mo'i tshogs la = sa dang lam rdzogs rig 'dzin rnams rnams la= bstan pa bsrung mdzad dam can rnams la = dgra bgegs bdud 'dul mnga' bdag tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// rtsa ba'i bla ma rgyud pa'i rje// dngos grub stsol ba'i yi dam lha// las byin rlobs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi dkon mchog gsum/ nang rtsa ba gsum/ gsang ba sku gsum/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpal thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ mchod pa 'bul lo/ sdig pa bshags so/ dge ba la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ sku mya ngan las mi 'da' bar 'gro ba sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad du gsol lo/ bcu gcig pa phyag rgya gar mchod ni/ slar yang bad gnyid kyi thugs 240) ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams kyis mchod pa'i rnam grangs mtha' dag rim pa bzhin 'bul bar dmigs te/ thog mar lha so so'i sku mdog phyag mtshan bzhugs stangs sogs ji lta ba'i rnam 'gyur dang mthun pa'i phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa bsam la/ hūm̐/ gdul bya'i mos blo tha dad pas// zhi dang khro dang 'dres pa'i tshul// sku mdog zhal phyag bsam 'das kyang*// lha nams gsal 'debs gar chod 'bul// hūm̐/ sde dpon che mchog he ru ka// dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal// rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog gsal// g.yas kyi phyag gsum rdo rje gdengs// g.yon gyi phyag gsum bhan dmar 'dzin// yum chen gnam zhal kun bzang mo// g.yas pa gtsor 'khyud kha ṭ+wā ga

g.yon pa chags pa'i dung dmar stob// yab yum thabs shes zung 'jug rgya// phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa bzhes// 241) ma hā mu dra pū dza ho/ hūm̐/ dpal chen badz+ra he ru ka// dbu gsum phyag drug = g.yad dkar rigs lngas = g.yas gsum rtse dgu kha ṭ+wā rnga*/ g.yon gsum dril bhan rgyu zhags bsnams /yum chen kro dhi shwa rim// g.yas pa gtso = g.yon pa dung = yab yum thabs shes = phyag rgya gar = ma hā mu dra pū dza ho/ hūm̐/ dpal len 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed// dbu gsum = g.yas dkar = rigs lngas = g.yas gsum be con ral gri sta// g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub mdung bhan dmar// yum chen badz+ra be tā li// g.yas pa gtsor = g.yon pa = yab yum = phyag rgya = ma hā mu = hūm̐/ dpal len rta mgrin pad+ma dbang*// dbu gsum = g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar zhal// dbu gtsug rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog rigs lngas = g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wā zhags// g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar sgrogs// 242) yum chen e ka dzā ṭi ma/ g.yas pa gtsor = g.yon pa chang = yab yum = phyag rgya = ma hā mu = hūm̐/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu che// dbu gsum = g.yas dkar = rigs lngas = g.yas gnyis rtse dgu rtse lnga ste// g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭ+wa ga mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu 'dril// yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma// g.yas pa = g.yon pa = yab yum thabs shes = phyag rgya = ma hā mu dra = hūm̐/ dpal chen bla med he ru ka// dbu gsum = g.yas dkar = rigs lngas = g.yas su rdo rje khyung sbrul zhags// g.yon gsum dung dmar zhing ga 'u// yum chen nyi zhi mu kha le// g.yas pa = g.yon pa = yab yum = phyag rgya = ma hā mu dra pū dza ho/ hūm̐/ dpal len rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal// zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis bgrad// sku mdog dkar dmar rus rgyan mdzes// rigs lngas = rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya bsgyur// yum chen chos 243) dbyings rnal 'byor ma// gnyis med 'khril sbyor bde chen bskyed// g.yas pa dung =

yab yum phyag rgya = ma hā = hūm̐/ dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul che// dbu gsum = g.yas dkar = rigs lngas dbu = g.yas gsum rdo rje lha brgyad mgo g.yon gsum bhan dmar klu brgyad mgo yum chen srid pa spyi 'dul ma// g.yas pa = g.yon pa = yab yum = phyag rgya = ma hā = hūm̐/ dpal chen stobs ldan nag po che// dbu gsum = sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa la = rigs lngas = g.yas gsum rdo rje lha brgyad snying*// g.yon gsum bhan dmar klu brgyad snying*// yum chen 'byung ba lnga yi bdag g.yas pa gzugs khams mkha' la 'degs// g.yon pa 'dod khams sa la gnon// yab yum = phyag rgya = ma hā mu dra pū dza ho/ hūm̐/ so so'i rigs bzhi 'khor tshogs rnams// zhal dang phyag mtshan cir yang bsgyur// bder gshegs thams cad gar gyi 244) bdag phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa bzhes// ma hā mu dra pū dza ho/ bcu gnyis pa nang 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa phul ba ni/ snang srid snod bcud kyi 'dod yon mtha' dag blos blangs nas phul zhing*/ oṃ/ mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni// sems kyi yid bzhin sprin tshogs gtibs// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya tshogs// 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa bzhes// oṃ sarba pū dza sa ma ya ho/ bco lnga pa gsang mchod ni/ nyon mongs pa dug lnga ye nas ye shes lngar lhun gyis grub pa'i rang bzhin du rtogs pa'i mchod pa 'bul zhing*/ hūm̐/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che// nga rgyal phrag dog nyon mongs lnga*// ye nas rigs lnga'i rang bzhin te// sbyor sgrol ting 'dzin dam chos bzhes// ha la pañtsa pū dza ho/ ha la pañtsa kha raṃ khā hi/ bcu drug pa de kho na nyid dug gsum gtan yan lag gi mchod pa ni 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i dug gsum po rtsad nas bcad pa'i phyir/ lha mo rnams kyis khams gsum sems can gyi rgyud la yod pa'i dug gsum thams cad gti mug sha/ 'dod chags 246) khrag zhe sdang rus pa'i rnam par gtogs kyi zhal du phul zhing mchod pas/

sems can gyi dug gsum bag chags dang labacas pa'i khungs stong par bsam la/ sha khrag rus pa rnam pa gsum// dug gsum mchod pa bla na med// ye nas sku gsum rang bzhin te// rang grol nyid du mchod pa bzhes// ma hā maṃ sa/ ma hā rak+ta/ ma hā keṃ ni ri ti khā hi/ bcu bdun pa bdud rtsi sman mchod bya ba la gsum ste/ sman gyi che ba'i yon tan brjod pa dang*/ lha tshogs rnams la ji ltar 'bul ba dang*/ sman gyi dngos grub blang ba dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ hūm̐/ rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i sman// rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos// ye shes lnga rdzogs sgrub pa'i rdzas// rgyud lnga sems can kun grol phyir// dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi che// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥthaḥ gnyis pa bdud rtsi 'bul ba la spyir 'bul ba dang*/ bye brag tu 'bul ba gnyis kyi dang po ni/ hūm̐/ rtsa brgyad yan lag stong 247) sbyar ba'i/

/thun mong mchog dang khyad 'phags 'di// dus gsum bla ma ya dam lha// rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod pa 'bul// thugs rje brtser dgongs dngos grub stsol// oṃ ā hūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hi/ bye brag rgyas par lha so so'i mtshan don ltar 'bul ba ni/ hrī/ dam skongs dbang dang shes rgyud lung ston pa'i// nges pa'i don ston rdo rje'i slob dpon la// rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// sangs rgyas bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis lha tshogs la// rnam dag = thugs rje brtser = khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas// che mchog yon tan lha tshogs 'khor bcas la// rnam dag = thugs rje = khrag 'thung rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas// yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs 'khor bcas la// = = gshin rje rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas// 'jam dpal sku 248) yi lha = dbang chen rol pa'i = pad+ma gsung gi = phur pa rol pa'i = phur pa phrin las = sha khrag rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// ma mo rbod gtong lha = thugs rje gdung chos sku yi dkyil 'khor nas// rig 'dzin bla ma'i lha tshogs = dug lnga me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs 'khor bcas la/ /= = gtum drag me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// dmod pa drag sngags = zhing chen bcal du dkram pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// bka' srung pho nya'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la// = = dkyil 'khor dgu yi bar 'khyams 'khor yug na// dpal gyi bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho la// = = sangs rgyas kyi bka' srung zhal bzhes pa'i// dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu 'khor bcas la// rnam dag bdud rtsi = thugs rje brtser dgongs dbang = oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba a mṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hi/

mtheb srin gnyis sbyar ba thabs shes kyi phyag rgyas bdud rtsi thigs pa gcig blang nas 249) rang gi gnas gsum du reg cing lce thog tu myang la/ lha tshogs thams cad mnyes nas dngos grub yi ge 'bru gsum gyi rnam pa rang gi gnas gsum du thim par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐/ lce yi dam tshig rdo rje la// dam tshig can gyis hūm̐ bsgom ste// mtheb srin thabs shes phyag rgya yis// myang na dngos grub mchog thob gyur// kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wāk+ka sid+dhi ā/ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ sarba sid+dhi hrīḥ bco brgyad pa gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ gtor ma'i ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la rnam pa 'dod yon gang la gang dgyes kyi rdzas dang yo byad gyis lha thams cad mnyes tshims du gyur bar dmigs shing*/ hūm̐/ dam rdzas rmad byung gtor chen po// 'dod yon lnga yi phung po 'bar// thams cad tshim byed chos sbyin che// zhi khro yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang*// ma hā ba lin+ta pū dza ho/ ma hā ba lin+ta kha ram̐ khā hi/ bcu dgu pa rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa ni/ stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i pā lar bstan pa'i ru dra bsgral ba'i khrag gis 250) bkang ste phul ba lha tshogs thams cad rngams pa'i tshul gyis gsol bar bsam la/ hūm̐/ ru dra bsgral ba'i khrag chen po// lcang lor bcas pa'i bhañdzar bskyil// 'khor ba dbyings su dag bya'i phyir// dpal chen tshogs kyi zhal du 'bul/ /ma hā rak+ta kha ram̐ khā hi/ nyi shu pa bdud rtsi bsang nan gyi mchod pa ni/ nas/ 'bras/ gro sbrang*/ shing tog dang bcas pa las ba'i dz+wa gad dpa' bo'i mchod pa phul bas lha tshogs thams cad mnyes par bsam la/ hūm̐/ rgyu gnyis rkyen sbyar 'bru bcud 'di// dug lnga sman gyur dam pa'i rdzas// dza gad dpa' bo'i bdud rtsi 'dis// rgyal ba zhi khro'i thugs dam bskang*// ma hā dza gad pū dza ho/ ma hā dza gad kha ram̐ khā hi/ nyer gcig pa sbyor ba'i mchod pa ni/

lha tshogs yab yum so so rnams ma chags thabs kyi sbyor ba lhan skyes zag med kyi ye shag nyams su bstar bas shes rab stong pa chos kyi dbyings dang thabs thabs bde chen rig pa'i ye shes dbyer med zung 'jug chen po mngon du mdzad par 251) mos la/ hūm̐/ dbyings rig gnyis sbyor ba yis// 'khor 'das gnyis su med par sbyor// gnyis med rtogs pa'i sbyor mchod 'dis// rgyal ba yab yum mnyes gyur cig dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho/ pad+ma yo gi nī sa ma ya pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ nyer gnyis bsgral mchod ni/ lha tshogs yab yum kun gyi sbyor mtshams nas sprul pa'i las mkhan 'khor tshogs grangs med pa nyi zer gyi rdul bzhin 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab nas ma rung log par spyod pa'i ru dra dam nyams rnams bsgral nas gzugs phung zhal du bzhes shing rnam shes chos dbyings su spar bas skye 'gro thams cad kyi 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rtsa ba ngar 'dzin rtsad nas bcad/ gzung 'dzin drung nas phyungs/ 'khor ba khungs nas stongs par gyur par dmigs te/ hūm̐/ yang dag don rtogs blo yis ni// ma rtogs sems can gnas su bsgral// dus gsum bder gshegs de la mnyes// mchog gi mchod pa chen po bzhes// oṃ ma hā shrī he ru ka/ ma traṃ ru dra 252) pra bañtsakra hūm̐ phaṭaḥ pra we sha ya phaṭa/ ti hūm̐ aḥyam̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ ces mchod pa'i rim pa thams cad grub nas lha mo dang khro tshogs sogs thams cad kyang gtso 'khor rnams la tshur thim pas lha thams cad stobs dang gzi brjid sngar bas lhag par bsam mo/ nyer gsum pa bstod pa'i las rim la spyi dang bye brag gi bstod pa gnyis kyi dang po lha tshogs spyi la sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi che ba'i yon tan la bstod pa ni/ ye shes kyi lha la bstod pas mnyes pa dang ma bstod pas lta bu'i 'dzin rtog mi mnga' yang bdag sogs 'gro ba'i tshogs gnyis spel zhing bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan la nges shes bskyed phyir sgo gsum gus pa chen pos bstod par bya ste/

oṃ/ mnyam nyid chos sku'i rang bzhin las// kun bzang zag pa med par bde// sems can don la de bzhin gshegs// thugs rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// āḥ rtsol med rang byung chos kyi sgra /ma 'gag rang gsal 'dzin pa med// chags med skyon bral pad+ma'i gsung*/ yang dag gsung la = hūm̐/ spros pa 253) med pa dbyings kyi ngang*// ma skyes 'jigs med rdo rje'i thugs/ /blang dor med pa chos kyi dbyings// 'gyur med thugs la = swā/ chos dbyings rol pa chen po las// rtsal dang rol pa mi dmigs kyang*// nam mkha' mdzod kyi cho 'phrul gyis// yon tan re skongs phyag 'tshal bstod// hā/ rang bzhin cir yang ma nges kyang*// dkyil 'khor chen po'i cha bzung nas// rtog med dreg pa ngang gis 'dul// phrin las mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ āḥhūm̐ na mo hri da ya oṃ na ma: gnyis pa bye brag tu bstod pa la rgyas par ni dkyil 'khor pho brang la gzhal yas don gyi bstod pa dang*/ lha tshogs rnams la mtshan grangs dang rgyan chas brda rtags kyi sgo nas bstod pa sogs mang yang*/ 'dir mdor bsdus dkyil 'khor tshom bur dril te bstod pa ni/ tshig dang mthun pa'i don yid la dran pa'i ngang nas bstod de/ hūm̐/ dus gsum bder gshegs chos rnams rdzogs pa'i dpal// zhi ba yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal 254) bstod// dus gsum bde gshegs yon tan rdzogs pa'i dpal// che mchog yongs rdzogs lha la = dus gsum bde gshegs thugs mchog rdzogs pa'i dpal// yang dag yongs rdzogs lha = dus gsum bde bshegs sku mchog rdzogs pa'i dpal// gshin rje yongs rdzogs = dus gsum bde gshegs gsung mchog rdzogs pa'i dpal// dbang chen yongs rdzogs = dus gsum bde gshegs phrin las rdzogs pa'i dpal// phur pa yongs rdzogs = dus gsum bde gshegs gzi brjid rdzogs = ma mo yongs = dus gsum bder gshegs phyag rgya rdzogs pa'i dpal// rig 'dzin yongs rdzogs lha =

dus gsum bde gshegs mngon spyod rdzogs pa'i dpal// 'jig rten yongs rdzogs lha = dus gsum bde gshegs dmod mthu rdzogs pa'i dpal// drag sngags yongs rdzogs lha = phrin las bzhi bsgrub phyi nang bar chad sel/ sgo ba sgo ma'i tshogs la = rgyal ba'i spyan sngar bstan pa'i gnyer blangs pa'i// bka' nyan srung ma'i tshogs la = phyi nang 255) gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la// bla med sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub rnams// bdag sogs mos pa'i bu la stsal du gsol// nyer bzhi pa bshags pa bya ba ni/ yi dam gyi lha yang ye gdod nas rang rig chos kyi sku dang tha dad me dacing 'du 'bral skad cig med kyang de ltar ma rtogs pas gnyis 'dzin mtshan ma'i bag chags lu gu rgyud kyis dngos grub kyi gegs su gyur pa de nyid bshags bya bshags byed las 'das pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag cing*/ hūm̐/ zhi khro bder gshegs yongs rdzogs dgongs// sngon nas rang dang mnyam nyid don// ma rtogs ris chen so sor bzung*// dbyer med rnam dag klong du bshags// sa ma ya e he shud+dh+re āḥ zhes he ru ka'i yig brgya yang bzla ste/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pa la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka teno pa tiṣ+tha/ dri d+dho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha 256) wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shrī yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka ma me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa ā hūm̐ phaṭaḥ nyer lnga pa 'dzab bsnyen bya zhing dngos grub blang ba la thog mar 'dzab la zhi khro gnyis las zhi bar bsnyen cing khro bor bsgrub/ ces gsungs pa'i zhi bsnyen la 'dzab kyi dgongs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor dgu'i lha thams cad kyi dbu rgyan rigs bdag gi lha ni spyi bo'i gtsug tu pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la khyab bdag kun bzang yab yum/

de'i mdun du mi skyod rdor sems yab yum dang*/ che mchog yon tan gyi lha rnams kyi dpral bar rin 'byung*/ rna ltag g.yas su rnam snang ltag par snang mtha'/ rna ltag g.yon du don grun yab yum ste/ so so'i 'khor tshogs kyang nyi ma la 'od zer zhar 'byung ltar lhun grub tu bzhugs par mos/ de bzhin du/ yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi gtsug tu kun bzang yab yum gyi mdun du rnam snang*/ dpral bar mi bskyod/ g.yas su rin 'byung*/ rgyab tu snang mtha'/ g.yon du don grub/ 'jam dpal sku'i lha tshogs la gzhan 'dra ba las dpral bar rnam snang*/ pad+ma gsung gsung gi lha tshogs dpral bar snang mtha'/ phur pa phrin las la dpral bar don grub/ mtshams bzhi'i shar lho bla med he ru kal che mchog ji lta ba dang*/ lho nub rig 'dzin la dpral bar rnam snang dang*/ mchodabastod drag sngags gnyis kyi dpral bar mi bskyod dang gzhan rnams mtshungs pa ste/ de ltar zhi ba'i lha tshogs thams cad dbu'i rgyan la rdzogs par bzhugs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gnas gsum du yi ge gsum dang thugs ka'i hūm̐ la rtsa sngags kyi bskor bar mos shing*/ lha thams cad kyi zhal nas 'dzab kyi sgra bsgrag pas/ sngags phreng las 'od zera'aphros pas stong gsum thams cad zhi ba'i lha tshogs dang sngags kyi sgras hur dir du song ba dang*/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs tshur bsdus nas lha rnams kyi thugs kar thim par dmigs la/ hūm̐/ gsang ba yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor du// tshe mchog dpal dgu'i dbu rgyan nang*// thabs shes nyi zla pad+ma'i steng*// mi skyod rnam par snang mdzad dang*// rin 'byung snang mtha' don yodagrub// yum chen kunabazang sangs rgyas spyan// mā ki gos dkar dam tshig sgrol// rgyal ba yab yum phyag mtshan bcas// kun bzang 258) yab yum dgyes par sbyor// sras mchog sems dpal sems mar bcas// sprul sku thub drug mthar byed brgyad// mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul can// gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar// dbu rgyan cod pan phreng ba dang*// do shal dpung rgyan se mo do// rin chen dar dpyang chas rnams rdzogs// gsung ni mang snying sngags sgra sgrog

/thugs ni rang byung ye shes gsal// 'dzab kyis sku gsung thugs rgyud bskul// spros pas stong gsum sku yi gang*// sku las gsung byon sngags 'brug ldir// bsdus pas chos dbyings mkha' la thim// ma gsal bar du bskyed cing sgom/ /ma sgrub bar du mi btang ngo*// zhes gsal gdab cing dam bcas la/ 'dzab dngos lagasum gyi dang po zhi ba dam pa rigs brgya'i rtsa sngags ni/ oṃ āḥli kā li dz+nyā na pañtsa satwa kro dha mu ni ye swā hā/ zhes bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi rtsa sngags ni/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dha tu āḥ gtso bo rigs lnga yab yum gyi snying po ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mum̐ lām̐ mam̐ pyam̐ tām̐/ zhes pa'i 'dzab rnams brgya stong khri 'bum sa sogs pa long skabs dang bstun te bzlas pa'i mthar stong tshig gi mchod pa ni/ bder gshegs zhi ba'i lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs// phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dzab bsnyen mchod pa 'bul// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrinalas bstod// nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis mthol lo bshags// ma hā pañtsa rak+ta ba lin+ta sarba pū dza khā hi/ zhi ba'i lha tshogs khyed sku ci 'dra dang*/ zhes sogs kyi smon lam yang gdab bo/ ༈ gnyis pa khro bor sgrub pa'i las rim gyi 'dzab dgongs ni/ de yang sgrub pa chen po'i skabs lta bur ni 'dzab dgongs rgyas pa'i gzhung ltar dgos mod kyang*/ las byang gi skabs 'dir ni/ phra mo'i ting 'dzin yid la gsal bas rang gi gnas sbyang ba/ bzlas brjod bsnyen pa'i 'phros 'dus ye shes kyi lha nye bar bsnyen pa/ gsang ba byang chub sems kyi 'phro 'dus dngos grub yum gyi mkhar bsdu ba dang gsum gyi 'dzab dgongs yin te/ de yang bdag nyid gtso bo yab yum dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar rigs 'dus ye shes 260) sems dpa' dkar po rdor sems kyi cha byad can du gsal ba'i thugs rin po che zur brgyad pa'i nang du nyi ma'i gdan la ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje rtse lnga sngon po'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gi mtha' skor du gtso bo'i sngags kyi bskor bar gsal ba ni rang gi gnas sbyang ba'o/

de nas 'dzab bzlas pa tsam gyis ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar bsgar ba'i sngags phreng sngo rgyangs gyi gyen du byung nas mgrin pa'i lam nas ljags kyi steng du gsung gi snying po āḥl bskor ba gcig byas/ slar shangs bug nas yar brgyud de spyi bo'i ā+oṃ la skor ba byas nas mar la shangs bug g.yon gyi sgor thon pa yum gyi shangs bug g.yas su zhugs shing thugs ka'i g.yaun la bskor bar byas te gsang ba'i pad+mor babs par bsam zhing 'dzab bzla ba ni ye shes kyi lha nye bar bsnyen pa'o/ de nas yum gyi mkha' dbyings nas sngags phreng las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas rgyal ba thams cad mchod/ de dag gi thugs rje byin rlabs dngos grub bsdus nas yum gyi pad+mar bskyil ba de yab kyi gsang rdor gyi rngub ste yar drangs nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par dmigs pa ni byang chub sems kyi 'phro 'dus dngos grub bsdu ba'o/ de lta bu gtso bo'i 'dzab dgongs 'di ni bsnyen sgrub yan lag

261) bzhi yongs rdzogs kyi dgongs pa yin pas gtso 'khor thams cad kyi 'dzab dgongs 'di kas 'grub par gsung mod kyi/ rgyas par spro na gtso brgyad rnams la gong gi 'di dang mtshungs par bsgom zhing*/ 'khor thams cad la thugs srog la sngags phreng gis bskor bar mos pa tsam gyis 'grub bo/ hūm̐/ dbus phyogs 'khor lo'i gzhal yas nas// zla gam dbang chen ye dkyil du// byol song gtso brgyad dregs pa'i steng*// thabs shes nyi zla'i 'od kyi dkyil// ma chags pad+ma'i ge sar la// bcom ldan che mchog he ru ka// yum chen gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma// gnyis med 'khril sbyor cha lugs ni// sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung*// rgod dang gshed dang snying rje rngam// 'bar khro zhi sogs gar dgur ldan// sku la dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs// gsung ni drag po'i sngags sgra sgrog thugs ni sgrol mdzad srog dang bcas// 'dzab kyi sku gsung thugs rgyud bskul// phaṭaḥkyis spros pas stong gsum 262)gang*/ bsdus pas yum gyi mkha' la 'khril// gsang ba'i sbubs nas thugs kar thim// ma gsal bar du bskyed cing sgom// ma thub bar du mi btang ngo*// oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces gtso mchog gi snying po nan tan du bzla zhing*/ 'khor rnams la ci nus skabs dang bstun nas rim par bzla'o/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ yang dag thugs kyi snying po'o/ oṃ hriṣ+ṭi wi tri tā na na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i snying po'o/ oṃ ha ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ pad+ma gsung gi snying po'o/ oṃ badz+ra ki li ki la ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ phur pa phrin las kyi snying po'o/ oṃ gu h+ya dz+nya na shrī he ru ka kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ma mo rbod gtong gi snying po'o/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba hūm̐ phaṭaḥ rig 'dzin slob dpon gyi snying po'o/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ phaṭaḥ

mchod bstod yongs rdzogs kyi snying po'o/ oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan e dza bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dmod pa drag sngags 'dus pa'i snying po'o/ hūm̐/ yang sprul khyung chen bka' sdod tshogs// bzlas brjod bsnyen pa'i mchod pa bzhes// oṃ khroṃ ga ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ sarba ḍāk+ki ni sa ma ya hring hring hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces sprul ba'i khyung chen dkar nag dang*/ dpal gyi bka' sdod rnams kyi srog sngags kyang cung zad bzla'o/ de ltar sgrub pa bka' brgyad tshom bu dgu'i lha tshogs so so'i 'dzab bsnyen sgrub pa'i mthar/ gsang sngags khro bo yongs 'dus kyi snying po bka' brgyad bdun brgya nyer lnga'i spyi dril bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gcig tu dril ba'i drag sngags chen mo spu gri reg chod gnas lcags thog rgod lta bu'i bzlas pa bya ba ni/ bdag nyid lus lha'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bdun brgya nyer lnga yongs rdzogs rnams ngag sngags kyi dkyil 'khor drag sngags so lnga pa lha thams cad kyi zhal nas 'brug stong dus gcig ldir ba bzhin stong khams gang bar sgrog pa/ sems chos nyid kyi dkyil 'khor dug gsum gtan sprugs khams gsum yongs sgrol chen po'i thugs rje'i stobs dang rig rtsal gyi ngar bskyed de/ bdag nyid kyi sku'i ba spu'i bu ga re re tshun chad nas ye shes kyi me'i tsha tsha gar gyi lcags sreg brdab pa 264) ltar 'phros shing me spungs gis snang srid khengs pas/ phyi skye 'gro sems can gyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i phung po/ nang sgrub po'i rnam rtog bag chags 'khrul 'dzin/ bar gdon bgegs 'byung po gnod byed kyi tshul du snang tshad srid tshad thams cad gzhob tu bsreg rdul du rlags/ skye med kyi dbyings su thim par dmigs la/ drag sngags chen mo 'di nyid gnam lcags kyi thog ltar bzla'o/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma krodhi shwa ri badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ ma hā yak+sha kā ma rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ

de nas stong tshig gi mchod pa ni/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs 'bul// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod// nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bshags// ma hā pañtsa ba lin+ta rak+ta khā hi/ de nas slar yang lha tshogs rnams la gtang rag gi tshul du bstod par bya ba ni/ dang po zhi ba'i lha tshogs la bstod bya ste/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan bder gshegs kun bzang rigs lnga yab// gdul pa 'dul phyir khrag 'thung sku lngar ston// 265) bzang mo la sogs kro dhi yum dang sbyor// sems dpal lcam dral mthar byed thub pa drug /dregs pa 'joms mdzad gtum rngams tshogs dang bcas// zhi ba yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir sku bskyod la// dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'di la brtan par bzhugs// gnyis med ngang du phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// sman gtor rak+ta sbyor dang bsgral mchod bzhes// nyams chags 'gal 'khrul pham ltung nyes byas bshags// zhi rgyas dbang drag las bzhi'i dngos grub stsol// gzhan sprul gnod byed thams cad bzlog pa dang*// bla med sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// de nas khro bo'i lha tshogs tshom bu dgu'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru ka// gnyis med yum chen gnam zhal dbyings phyug 'khril// rigs bzhi he ru yab yum yon tan bcas/ /sprul pa'i khro bcu sgo skyong 'khor gyis bskor// 266) bder bshegs dgongs 'dus che ba'i yon tan rgyas// che mchog yongs rdzogs lha = bcom ldan dpal len badz+ra he ru ka// gnyis med yum chen kro dhi shwa ri 'khril// khrag 'thung rigs bzhi yab yum thugs kyi sras// gnas dang yul gyi ma tshogs sgo mar bcas// dri med rnam dag thugs mchog 'gyur ba med// yang dag rdzogs lha = bcom ldan sde dpon 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/

sku lnga sbyar dang dug lnga sbyor yum 'khril// gshed bzhi yab yum sku yi sras dang bcas// phyogs skyong ging bdud sgo bzhi phra men bskor// rab 'jigs rngams pa'i sku mchog khyad par che// gshin rje yongs rdzogs lha la = bcom ldan sde dpon pad+ma rta mgrin dbang*// pad+ma gzi ldan bde chen yum mchog 'khril// dbang chen rigs bzhi yab yum gsung gi sras// phra men zil gnon khro rgyal sgo bar bcas// gsung gi dbang phyug rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog dbang chen yongs rdzogs sku = bcom ldan dpal chen 267) rdo rje gzhon nu che// gsang chen rgyas mdzad 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'khril// phrin las sras bzhi khro bcu yab yum bcas// za gsod ma tshogs ming po sgo bas bskor// phrin las bdag nyid rtsal chen 'gro ba 'dul// phur pa yongs rdzogs lha la = bcom ldan sde dpon bla med he ru ka// dgyes mdzad yum chen nyid zhi mu kha le// rtag rgyal ma lnga bde chen kun bskyed sras// ye shes rje mo sman mo sgo skyong tshogs// las kyi bdag mo ma mo rbod gtong 'gyed// ma mo yongs rdzogs lha = bcom ldan sde dpon rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal/ /gnyis med yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor 'khril// thugs kyi sras mchog slob dpon rigs bzhi dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mo sgo bzhi srung mdzad bcas// rgyud lung man ngag 'gro 'dus rig pa 'dzin// rig 'dzin yongs rdzogs lha la = dregs pa kun 'dul khro rgyal mi zad pa// khams gsum srid pa spyi 'dus yum 268) mchog 'khril// thugs sras pho nya sde bzhi yab yum bcas// sde dpon 'khor bcas sgo skyong dregs pa'i tshogs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las rnams ci bcol bsgrub// 'jig rten yongs rdzogs lha = mthu stobs rtsal ldan rab gtum khro bo'i rgyal// 'byung lnga'i bdag mo yum chen sku la 'khril// thugs sras sngags bdag las mkhan sde bzhir bcas// dam tshig dbang gis bstan srung sngags bdag tshogs// dregs pa bco brgyad gdug pa'i mtshon ngar can// drag sngags yongs rdzogs lha la =

dus gsum rgyal ba yongs rdzogs spyan snga ru// dam mnon rang rtags srog gi snying po phul// bka' stsal gnyer blangs rdzu 'phrul gar gyi bdag ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung la sogs// dkyil 'khor tshul 'dzin rnal 'byor yongs la skyobs// bka' srung yongs rdzogs lha la = hūm̐/ rnam dag ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas// 'gro don 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i gtso dang 'khor// ji ltar sprul yang ye shes rig pa'i rtsal// rang shar rang grol bde chen g.yung drung lha// rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos pas// thams cad chos skur yongs rdzogs lha la bstod// bdun brgya nyer lnga rgyal ba thugs dam can// mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir sku bskyod la// zhes pa la sogs pa'i 'dod gsol rnams gong gi zhi ba'i mjug cha mtshungs par bya'o/ de ltar 'dzab bsnyen bstod pa dang bcas pa grub rjes/ thun la mtshams su dngos grub blang ba ni/ bdag nyid kyi thugs srog hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros te rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro dam can chos srung thams cad la phog pas thugs dam kyi rgyud bskul/ so so'i sku gsung thugs kyi gnas rnams nas byin rlabs mchog thun gyi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer lnga ldan gyi tshul du byung nas bdag gi gnas gsum su thim par bsam la/ hūm̐/ lha dang rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dgongs// 'dir 'dus rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams// smin grol gnyis kyi rgyud sbyangs shing*// bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi las 270) gzhung srong*// bsnyen sgrub rnam gsum mtha' ru phyin// las dang thugs rje mthun pa yi// zhi rgyas dbang drag yid bzhin gter// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kā ya wak+tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐ āḥ de yan chad kyi dngos gzhi'i las rim nyer lnga rnams grub nas/ ༈ gsum pa rjes kyi las rim bcu gcig ni/

rtsa tho las che ba bskyed cing*/ phrin las bskul/ tshogs dang*/ lhag chog gtor sbyong bya/ gtor zor/ bstan ma rnam bzhi'i bro/ dkyil 'khor bsdu/ bkang rgyun spyod bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i dang por/ chog gzhung la lar thugs bsam bskul ba sogs tshogs kyi las rim grub pa'i rjes thog tu 'byung mod kyi/ 'dir ni bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi go rim dang bstun nas skabs 'dir byung bar snang bas/ de las thog mar bka' sdod pho nya'i tshogs la phrin las gzhol bar byed pa la rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ma ldan na srung ma dam la mi 'du/ zil gyis mi non/ las la mi khol ba'i phyir/ bdag nyid ye gdod ma nas rang bzhin chos sku kun tu bzang po'i ngo bor lhun gyis grub pa'i 271) rang mdangs 'gag med kyi rol pa las gzugs snang thams cad lha sku sgra sgrag thams cad sngags/ dran rtogs thams cad chos nyid kyi rnam rol yin la yin par shes pa'i nga rgyal gyi dpa' gdengs bskyed la/ hūm̐/ snang srid thams cad gzhal yas khang*/ gzugs snang thams cad he ru ka/ thams cad thams cad bran du khol// nga las che ba su yang med// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes che ba bskyed pas snang srid thams cad mnga' 'og tu 'dus pas ci bsgo ba'i bka' nyan par bsam mo/ ༈ gnyis pa phrin las bskul ba ni/ tshom bu dgu'i lha tshogs rnams la 'gro ba'i don du thugs dam bskul ba tsam gyis/ lha tshogs thams cad las rang 'dra'i sprul pa grangs med nyi zer gyi rdul bzhin spros te 'jig rten gyi khams gang bas 'jigs brgyad zhi ba dang*/ 'byor drug rgyas pa dang*/ mos pa rnam bzhi dbang du bsdu ba dang*/ dgra bgegs 'byung po rdul du rlog pa sogs phrin las gang 'dod thams cad 'bad med du bsgrub par dmigs la/ hūm̐/ chos sku skye med ngang nyid las// gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs bzhengs// zhi rgyas dbang drag mngon spyod las//

272) bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// hūm̐ sarba duṣ+ṭan/ oṃ shan+ting*/ swa puṣ+ṭiṃ/ a wa shaṃ/ hā ma ra ya phaṭa/ sarba sid+dhi ku ru hūm̐/ rbod zor sarba zlog bh+yoḥ ༈ gsum pa tshogs kyi las rim rnams kyi dang por bsang sbyang*/ byin gyis brlab pa ni/ 'dod yon gyi longs spyod thabs shes bza' btung gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ma tshang ba med cing ser sna dang rlom sems kyis ma bslad par bsags nas zhing chen g.yang gzhi'i stag pags sogs kyi gdan khar bshams la/ rdo rje'i phyag mtshan dang bcas pas bdud rtsi'i zer gyis khyab par 'thor te/ oṃ u ts+tsha ṣ+ma bai tā li kro dha ni/ sarba drā phyaṃ paṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭaḥswā hā/ zhes khro mo nyes sgrib za byed ma'i sngags kyis bgegs sbyang*/ de nas rang rig ma bcos spros med rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis 'khor 'das bzang ngan gtsang rtsogs sogs kyi rnam par rtog pa bden med sgyu mar shes pa'i ngang nas/ bdag bskyed kyi thugs srog hūm̐ las yi ge ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros pa las byung ba'i ye shes kyi me rlung chu gsum gyis dri ma sbyang*/ ā+oṃ 273) āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis zag med kyi logs spyod du byin brlabs par mos la/ hūm̐/ rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyis// chos kun thams cad sgyu mar rig /rig pa'i ye shes ram̐ yam̐ kham̐// tshogs kyi dngos po bsregs sbyang bkru// ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ ram̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ sam̐ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ yam̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ sam̐ ha ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lhar gsal thugs las sbyang yig 'phros// ram̐/ ram̐ las me byung dngos 'dzin bsreg yam̐/ yam̐ las rlung byung bag chags gtor// kham̐/ kham̐ las chu byung gnyisa'adzin bkru// rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas// byin gyis rlobs pa'i yi ge spro// hūm̐/ hūm̐ gis rnam par rtog pa sbyang*// āḥ/ āḥyis ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur// oṃ/ oṃ gis 'dod yaun snang ?....// hrīḥ

hrīḥyis thugs kar lha tshogs dgye'o// zhes byin brlab cing*/ ༈ de nas tshogs mgron spyan drangs 274) shing phyag mchod bya ba ni/ bdag nyid kyi thugs ka nas tshad med bzhi'i lha mo dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas rnams nas rgyal ba sras bcas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can mtha' dag spyan drangs nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par mos la/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams// ye shes rol pa'i tshogs la gshegs// dam tshig dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir bzhugs// bdag dang gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos// mdzes snyan dri zhim ro bda' zhing*/ reg bde glu gar chos yid tshim// 'dod yon mchod pas thugs dam bskang*// de nas tshogs mchod kyi bskang ba bya ba'i sngon du bskang yul rnams la snyan gsan dbab pa'i dgongs gsol ni/ zhi khro bder gshegs yongs rdzogs lha// 'gro la phan mdzad thugs rje'i bdag sems can yongs kyi gnyen gcig pu// kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol// zhes pa'i mthar bshags skongs dngos ni/ tshor dang ma tshor ba'i dam tshig nyams chags mtha' dag mnong 275) dang bcas pas mthol bshags bya ste/ hūm̐/ shar nas badz+ra akaṣo bh+ya/ rdo rje rigs kyi thugs dam las// zhe sdang dam tshig nyams so 'tshal// 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags// lho nas rat+na sam+bha wa// rin chen rigs kyi thugs dam las// nga rgyal dam tshig nyams so 'tshal// 'di yang mi 'chab = nub nas pad+ma de wa hrīḥ pad+ma rigs kyi thugs dam las// 'dod chags dam tshig nyams so 'tshal// 'di yang = byang nas a mo gha sid+dhi// las kyi rigs las thugs dam las// las kyi rigs kyi thugs dam las// phrag dog dam tshig nyams = 'di yang = dbus nas bai ro tsa na oṃ// de bzhin rigs kyi thugs dam las// gti mug dam tshig nyams = 'di yang = yang yang mi byed mthol lo bshags// lang lang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags// hūm̐/

rtsa ba'i dam tshig gso ba'i phyir// mched dang slob dpon thugs dam bskang*// mi spang dam tshig gso ba'i phyir//gnyis su med pa'i = dang du blang ba'i dam tshig las// nyams pa gso bar bya ba'i phyir// 276)dam rdzas lnga yi thugs dam bskang*// spyad par bya ba'i dam tshig las// nyams pa gso = sbyor dang sgrol ba'i thugs dam bskang*// sgrub par bya ba'i dam tshig las// nyams pa gso = rigs lnga dag pas thugs dam bskang*// shes par bya ba'i dam tshig las// nyams pa = phung po zhig khrol 'di yi thugs dam bskang*// hūm̐/ bskang ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis bskang*// sbyor ba med de srid gsum yongs la sbyor// sgrol ba med de dug gsum ye nas sgrol// ye sbyor ye sgrol chen pos thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni// rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi dang*// khyad par rmad du byung ba'i lagator ma dang*// 'khor ba rgyu las bsgral ba'i rak+ta dang*// rnam dag rgyud las byung ba'i baṃ chen dang*// 'bru bcud stong las sbyar ba'i dzā gad dang*// phyi nang mchod pa'i tshogs kyi yo byad kyis// bka' rgyud bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang*//

khro bo rol pa'i 277) dkyil 'khor chen po nas// che mchog yon tan lha tshogs = khrag 'thung rol pa'i = yang dag thugs kyi lha = gshin rje rol pa'i dkyil 'khor = 'jam dpal sku yi = dbang chen rol pa'i = pad+ma gsung gi = phur pa rol pa'i = phur pa phrin las lha = sha khrag rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// ma mo rbod gtong = thugs rje gdung tshob sku yi dkyil 'khor nas// rigala'adzin bla med lha = dug lnga me ltar 'bar ba'i = 'jig rten mchod bstod = gtum drag me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// dmod pa drag sngags lha = dkyil 'khor dgu yi bar 'khyams 'khor yug nas// bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*// zhing chen bcal du bkram pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// pho nya las byed tshogs kyi = sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i// sngags bdag sde dpon sum cu'i = pho rgyud mgon po'i tshogs kyi = ma rgyud lha mo'i tshogs kyi= gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs = drang srong gza' yi tshogs kyi = 278) dam can dpe srog gtsang gsum thugs dam bskang*// yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba zhi khro rdo rje slob dpon dang*// bder gshegs yongs rdzogs srung ma dam tshig can// sku gsum gdung tshob rdo rje lcam dral mched// dpang gyur skyabs mchog ma lus dgongs su gsol// bdag ni ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyi// slob dpon mched sogs sku smad ngan smra zhing*// yi dam sngags dang phyag rgya gsang ba'i bsgrags// rtsa ba'i dam las 'gal gyur mthol lo bshags/ /shes bya lnga dang spyad par bya ba lnga*// mi spang lnga dang bsgrub par bya ba lnga*// dang len lnga sogs yan lag dam tshig rnams// nyams gyur rang mnong 'gyod pa mthol lo bshags// sngags la the tshom bla med theg pa smod// lta spyod ya bral bsnyen sgrub gzhung ma srong*// long yod le los dus kyi mchod pa chag

sdom gsum thun mong dam nyams mthol lo bshags// rigs pa'i rtsal chung snying po'i don ma rtogs// sgom 279) pa'i sran chung gnas lugs so ma thub// blo yi stobs chung spyod pa'i bog ma thon// legs sam spyod kyang don la thugs 'gal bsags// 'bras bus yid smon lus pa mthol lo bshags// yig brgya brjod/ hūm̐/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir// gsang ba'i pho brang bzhugs bzhin bkod nas kyang*// sgrub rdzas gnyan po tshul bzhin bkram lags na// rgyal ba zhi khro'i thugs dam gnyan bskongs te// rnal 'byor bdag la g.yar dam gsor stsol cig oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ de nas tshogs kyi yo byad che chung ji tsam yod pa de thams cad gsil nas mang du spros la/ dkyil 'khor la ji tsam 'bul rgyu de la'ang rim pa gsum ste/ dang po phud/ bar pa nyams bshags/ tha mas gnod byed bsgral stabs bya rgyu dang*/ bar du sgrub pa po rnams dngos grub tu longs spyod rgyu dang*/ tshogs lhag la yang yar gnas kyi mgron rnams la gtsang lhag dang*/ mar gnas rnams la sgrub pa po rnams kyi longs spyad pa'i 280) lhag ma bsdu ba'am 'on kyang deng sang gi cho ga ba nus ldan dgon pa'i gshis kyis rdo rje slob dpon gcig pu'i bzhes lhag la brten pa'i phyag srol nyid legs par snang ngo*/ de las thog par tshogs phud rim pa gsum gyi dang po tshogs kyi rtse mo dang bza' btung thamasacad kyi phud bsdus nas rin chen snod du spungs te dkyil 'khor ram gtor ma'i drung du 'bul zhing*/ tshogs kyi mchod pa de las gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i mchod pa thogs pa'i lha mo grangs me 'phros pas mchod yul thams cad mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul bar dmigs shing*/ hūm̐/ bla med mchog gi mchod sbyar bas// ye shes lnga yi 'odazer 'phro// 'dod yon lha mos rab brgyan 'bul// dam skongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// oṃ na mas+sa rba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ

sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na kha swā hā/ tshogs phud bar pa yang sngar bzhin gtor ma'i drung du phul zhing bshags tshig brjod pas/ tshogs gtor dang mchod pa'i dngos po zhen cing ma tshang ba dang sgo gsum gyi spyod pa la sogs pa'i nyes skyon dag cing thugs 281) dam skongs par mos la/ ma rig bag chags lus ngag sems// bag med dam 'gal 'byor tshogs chung*// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi// thugs dang 'gal gyur bzod par gsol// a ho ma hā su kha sa ma ya ho/ tshogs phud bla ma la bsgral stabs bya ba ni/ de yang sgrub chen nam gtor zlog sogs drag las rgyas par bya ba'i skabs dag tu ni liṅga sogs bca' gzhi tshang ma dang*/ phur thun tshom bu bskul ba sogs gdab pa las brgyad rdzogs par bya dgos mod kyi/ las gzhung rgyun khyer gyi skabs 'dir ni tshogs tha ma la brten nas dgug bsgral stabs gsum mdor bsdus tsam bya ba yin te/ tshogs tha ma de nyid zan dang sha khrag rus gsum gtso bor spungs nas lcags lder lta bu drag po'i snod gcig tu bshams la/ sgrol ba'i phyag rgya lcags phur sogs kyang gsar nas/ brjod tshig dang mthun pa'i ting 'dzin gsal ngar dang ldan pas/ bdag nyid gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i che mchog badz+ra kī la ya mthing nag phyag gnyis phur bu 'dril zhing*/ sku stod khro bo 282) chen po la sku smad gnam lcags kyi phur pa rab tu rno bas gtams pa me spungs kyi klong na rngams par bzhugs pa'i mdun na/ lcags kyi khang sgrom sgo med 'jigs su rung ba'i nang du gnod byed bsgral ba'i zhing du gyur pa gang yin de dag dbang po skye mched tshang zhing yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa mngon sum du gsal bar gyur/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang rgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi = dge 'dun gyi =

gsang sngags rigs sngags dang gzungs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ yi dam zho khro rab 'byams sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha tshogs bdun brgya nyer lnga sprul 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/ gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho dkar phyogs yul lha gzhi bdag dang bcas pa'i bden 283) pa dang*/ don dam chos kyi dbyings rnam dag cing kun rdzob brten cing 'brel par 'byung ba rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa chen po'i stobs la brten nas*/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smod pa/ dge 'dun gyi spyi dgra byed pa/ sems can yongs la gnod pa khyad par du yang rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku la bsdo ba/ mched dag lcam dral gyi dam las 'gal ba/ rnal 'byor sgrub pa po la gnod cing 'tshe ba/ dam pa'i chos dang byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra gzugs med kyi bgegs/ las ngan gyi sri/ bka' las 'da' ba/ dam las nyams pa/ khrims las dral ba/ zhing bcur gyur pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po gang yin pa de dag srid pa gsum gang du gnas kyang*/ pho nya las mkhan dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kyi lcagasakyus snying nas bzung ste rangadabang medapar skad 284) cig tsam la tshogs tha ma 'di la khug dzaḥ nṛ tri badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ho/ zhes rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas pas bkug bstim bya/ de nas lha tshogs rnams drag po'i phrin las bskul te/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings las rang byung sgrub pa'i lha// khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas// shin tu mi bzad rab 'jigs skur ston pa// dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzod// hūm̐ hūm̐ bi shwa kro dha dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ phaṭaḥ de nas mgon skyobs byed pa'i lha srung dang ni/

hūm̐ badz+ra ya k+sha kro dha a nṛ de wa ma nu shag phyo phyo/ de nas bdag nyid he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis phur pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung ste liṅga la gzir bas/ 'khor 'das sems su thag chod pa ni rig pa tshom bu ye shes kyi phur pa/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can 'khrul pa a 'thas kyi dgra bgegs la tshad med snying rje bskyed pa ni gsal gdangs longs sku snying rje'i phur pa/ lag pa'i sor mo bcu po khrag 'thung rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba'i sras su badz+ra ki la 285) pa byung ba ni sprul sku rdzas kyi phur pa ste/ bdag phur dben gsum sku gsum gyi rnam rol du shes pa ni lta ba'i rdzong yin zhingaphur pa'i dbal rtser hūm̐ yig las me 'od 'phros gnod byed de'i snying dkyil du yid kyi rten dbugs kyi dngas ma gtor/ srog gi rten khrag gi dngas ma skam/ tshe bsod kyi rten a yig dkar po phur pa'i rtse la tshur byung ba bdag gi snying gar bstim/ rnam shes kyi nṛ ljang gu phur pa'i khong seng nas yar brgyud dai dpal chen po he ru ka'i sku gsung thugs la bstim zhing*/ slar yang yab kyi dbu ma'i lam brgyud nas yum gyi gsang bar babs pa sprul ba'i sras mchog tu bltams shing shing 'gro ba'i don mdzad par dmigs pa ni sgom pa'i 'phrang*/ de lta bu gsal stong zung 'jug thabs shes dbyer med kyi sgo nas sgrol ba ni spyod pa'i srog ste/ rdzong 'phrang srog gsum tshang ba'i ting 'dzin dang ldan pas/ gzugs ling gtub cing*/ hūm̐/ nga ni che mchog he ru ka// g.yas pa thabs kyi rang bzhin la// g.yon pa shes rab rang bzhin te// thabs dang shes rab sbyar ba las// sras mchog badz+ra kī la 286) ya// gang la bya ba khyed kyis shes// yid la brnag pa'i dgra bgegs 'di// ma thugs myur du sgrol bar mdzod// ces pa'i mjug tu drag sngags so lnga pa'i gsham du/ karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ/
