dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bsgral zhing gnas spar bas 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs bsgrubs te/ sha khrag gzugs kyi phung po'i lhag rol de nyid sha'i phung po/ khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i ri bor gyur pa de dag lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du stabs pas rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs shing 'khor ba'i rgyu rkyen rtsad nas chod par bsam la bsgral ba'i ro ma rnams dkyil 'khor du 'bul zhing*/ dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs zhal phye cig bag chags kun sbyong 'khor ba'i lam dgag phyir// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dug gsum sha khrag rus// za byed mi'agyur chos nyid klong du rol// brdza yak+sha kro dha bi dza ye khā hi/ de ltar dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la tshogs mchod grub pa'i rjes la lhag ma'i mgron yar gnas ye shes sa la 'bul rgyu'i gtsang lhag snod 287) bzang por blug nas dkyil 'khor gsum du bzhag pa dang*/ bar 'dir slob dpon mched lcam rnams tshogs kyi dngos grub blang ba ni/ lha tshogs kyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros pas tshogs la thim pas yid bzhin nor bu ltar ci 'dod kyi dngos grub 'byung bar mos la/ tshogs rdzas kyi dngos po gang yod na tshad du rim par drangs shing*/ ho/ zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di// 'dod yon ma spangs longs spyod brgyan// dngos grub sna tshogs 'di las 'byung*// rnal 'byor dgyes par tshogs la rol// sid+dhi pha la a la la ho/ zhes brjod nas rang rang sgo gsum lha'i rnal 'byor dang sdan pas tshogs la rol zhing*/ de tshe tshogs kyi rdzas la bzang ngan zhim mngar gyi spong len mi bya/ tshogs rdzas la tha mal gyi ming mi 'bod/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdzas yin pas zos lhag sogs gang byung du mi bskyur/ bzi ba dang ku co 'thab rtsod bag med pa'i spyod pa mi bya/ rdo rje'i glu gar bya ba gsungs na'ang gsang sngags zab mo'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rdo rje'i tshig dang grub pa'i rig 'dzin dag gis nyams rtogs

288) par shar ba'i rdo rje'i mgur sogs ma gtogs 'jig rten gyi glu gar mi bya ba la sogs mdor na tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dam tshig rnams mi 'gal bar bya zhing*/ mjug tu/ he ru ka yi dkyil 'akor du// tshogs kyi khor los mchod pa yis// bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa// dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog ces pa'i smon lam kyang gdab bo/ bzhi pa lhag ma'i cho ga la/ tshogs gzhong sogs snod rnams kyi nang du lhag rol ji tsam yod pa thams cad che ba gcig tu spungs pa'i khar rdo rje slob dpon gyi bzhes lhag rnams bcug la/ slob ma nus ldan yin na sor mo nang du bsnol ba rdo rje dra mig gi phyag rgya'i khong seng nas/ bdud rtsi a mṛ ta zhal du 'thogs pa'i zhal phru phyag rgya'i khong seng nas lhag ma la btab cing*/ nus par mi ldan na bdud rtsi sman bdud rtsi sman rag 'thor bas chog pa nyid de/ bdag gi dpal gyi thugs srog las 'od zer oṃ āḥhūṃ gis mtshan pa 'phros te tshogs lhag gnyis la phog pa tsam gyis/ yar gnas mar gnas kyi mgron rigs so so'i thugs dang mthun pa'i 289) dngos po gang la ci 'dod du gyur par dmigs nas 'bru gsum lan bdun nam gsum gyis brlab ste/ thog mar yar gnas rnams la gtsang lhag 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings skye med rnam dag las// skye ba'i cho 'phrul zhi khro'i tshogs// 'dir byon rgyan gyis mchod gtor bzhes// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// oṃ ā hūm̐/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ/ sarba dharma ṇaṃ/ ud+ya nut+pan+natwad/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes gtsang lhag nam mkhar 'thor zhing*/ bdud rtsi gsang nan kyang 'di skabs lhan cig 'bul ba'i phyag bzhes snang*/ chog gzhung gzhan la lar 'di la gnam phud ces kyang grags pa de dang don gcig go de nas gong du bshad pa'i lha mo dngos de nyid mar gnas rnams la 'bul ba ni/ rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal gyis lhag mgron rnams bkug cing zil gyis mnan par mos te/

'di la yang rim pa bzhi yod de/ dang po dbang phyug dang mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis/ gnyis pas ging pho mo rnams dang*/ gsum pas ma 290) bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma pho nya rnams dang*/ bzhi pas laṅga dang 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro lha srin sde brgyad sogs mchod pa'i rim pa ni/ hūm̐/ dang por phud kyis mi mchod du// bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs lha rnams gnyan// bar du lhag mas mi mchod du// ma dang mkha' 'gro lhag la dgyes// tha ma gcig tu mi bsre ru// chos nyid ye nas rgyu 'bras gcig hūm̐/ dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud ma// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro shugs 'gor bcas// dbang phyug chen mo nyer brgyad dang*// mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis rnams// gnas bzang de ni dur khrod 'dzin/ /gos bzang de ni zhing chen gyon// skyogs bzang de ni bhañdza thogs// zas bzang de ni maṃ sa gsol// skyem bzang de ni rak+ta 'thung*// dam tshig bsrung zhing mkha' la 'gro zas su sha dang khrag la dgyes// las su gsod dang gcod la brtson// sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la// 291) sngon tshe dpal gyi bka' bzhin du// bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par mdzod// hūm̐/ dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud ma// skyes mchog ging chen bco brgyad po// dbu la ral phur sha ra ra// phyag na gri thog zings se zing*/ ging pho dgu ni sha ra ra// ging mo dgu ni si li li// thams cad ru mtshon chems se chem/ dam tshig bsrung zhing mkha' la 'gro zas su sha dang khrag la dgyes// las su gsod dang gcod la brtson// sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sngon tshe dpal gyi bka' bzhin du// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// hūm̐/ dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud ma// ma mo bdun dang sring mo bzhi// 'bar ma chen mo brgyad rnams dang*// pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi rnams// mdzes pa'i sku la sgeg tshul can// dur khrod rgyan cha 292) spungs se spung*// rnal 'byor kun gyi srod myul zhing*// sgrub pa po yi grogasamadzad ma// dam tshig bsrung =

zas su sha dang = las su gsod dang = sha khrag gtor ma = sngon che dpal = bcol ba'i phrin las hūm̐/ dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud ma// laṅka dur khrod bdag mo dang*// 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// lha srin sde brgyad thams cad kyang*// dur khrod rdzas la longs spyod cing*// bstan pa'i dgra bgegs gnyan por che// dam tshig bsrung zhing = zas su sha dang = las su gcod dang = sha khrag gtor ma= sngon tshe dpal = bcol ba'i phrin las = oṃ ma hā shrī he ru ka/ sa ma ya de wi kro dha sarba ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa badz+ra a dhiṣ+ṭa/ sa mu dra kra ma/ sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥbh+yo bh+yo bh+yo a ra li dzaḥ

zhes pas phul zhing lhag ma sgrub khang gi phyi rol gtsang sar spungs la 293) bzhag ste snod chus bshal la de phyogs su 'thor ro/ tshogs lhag 'di dpal gyi bka' sdod srung ma'i rigs thams cad kyi tshogs mchod yin tshe/ de dag gnyan la ru dog pa khang rkyen pas na/ lhag chog la brnyas bcos dang sgyid ngan mi rung bas gnad bsnun du byas na phrin las 'grub pa'i gnad yod par gsungs so/ ༈ de ltar 'di yan chad kyis rgyun gyis las gzhung dkyus ma rnams grub pa yin tshe mjug chog bsngo smon shis brjod bya ba'am/ gtor ma 'bul rgyu lta bu yod na skabs 'dir dam tshig chad mdo bsgrags nas gtor ma phul la brtan ma skyong byas pa'i mjug tu bsdu chog bya ba yin la/ gal te drag po mngon spyod kyi las bsgrubs pa'i dus bzang chen gal chen lta bu'i skabs su gtor ma 'phang ba'i las rim rgyas par byed na/ thog ma gtor ma'i bca' gzhi rgyas par dgos phyir/ gtso bor dgu ka'i gtor ma zur gsum gri ris can la 'khor rigs bzhi bzhi dang phrag ji tsam shong shong mtheb kyu dang bcas pas bskor zhing*/ sha khrag sogs gtor rgyan ci bzang dang 294) dpal gyi bka' sdod la'ang sngar bshad pa bzhin bya/ gal te cis kyang gtso bo dgu tha dad ma 'byor bar snod gcig tu bsdom pa'i tshe na ni ka ṭo ra'am lcags slang sogs che ba'i nang du spungs dgos te/ lar yang gsang sngags bla med kyi cho ga'i rigs la gtor tshogs spungs pa bzhin ma bskyed na lha tshogs thugs dam mi skongs/ de ma khongs na dngos grub mi 'byung pa'i bar chad dang 'khu ldog gi rgyu rkyen du 'gyur phyir gtor tshogs bzang bar gal che zhing*/ de ltar phrin las drag po'i thugs dam bskul bar bya ba'i tshig mdor bsdus ni las gzhung 'di nyid nas byung na gong du smos na'ang*/ gal chen skabs 'dir gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi bskul byar rgyas 'bring ci rigs bya bar gsungs pa bzhin/

lha tshogs bdun brgya nyer lnga'i bskul byang bsdus pa 'di bya ste/ thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod gtor rol mo'i sgra mi rkang gi gling bu sogs thugs dam rgyud bskul gyi yo byad ci 'dzom dang bcas gtor ma bskul nas sman rag sbreng*/ sgrub pa po rnams ting 'dzin gyi ngar dang dad gdung gi shugs bskyed la 'di ltar bskul bar bya'o/ hūm̐/ mi mngon dbyingasan bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs// bzhengs 295) shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs// bskul lo bskul lo sems can don du bskul// mdzod cig mdzod cig drag po'i phrin las mdzod// hūm̐/ zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// seng ge glang chen la sogs khri steng na// bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i yum dang 'khril// rigs bzhi yab yum sems dpa' lcam dral dang*// yid chos thub drug mthar byed brgyad la sogs// bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba thugs dam can// dbyings nas sku bskyod dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// hūm̐/ dbus phyogs gtso brgyad nyi zla sa steng na// dpal chen che mchog gnam zhal yum dang 'khril// rigs bzhi yab yum phyogs skyong 'dul byed bcu// ta krid bzhi dang lce spyang ma brgyad sogs// che mchog yon tan yongs rdzogs lha tshogs ni// sum cu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba thugs dam can// dbyings nas sku = thugs dam rgyud bskul = 296) shar phyogs ru dra nyi zla pad steng du// dpal len badz+ra he ru kro dhi 'khril// rigs bzhi yab yum ki ping bcu drug dang*// sgo skyong bzhi dang dbang mo nyer brgyad sogs// thugs dam yang dag yongs rdzogs lha tshogs ni// lnga bcu rtsa brgyad rgyal = dbyings nas = thugs dam rgyud = hūm̐/ lha tshogs chu glang nyi zla pad steng du/ /sde dpon gshin rje'i gshed po bai tā 'khril// sgrol ba'i yum dang rigs bzhi yab yum dang*// phyogs skyong gshin rje yab yum sgo skyong bcas// gri thogs ging sogs pho nya bcu drug ste// lnga bcu rtsa dgu =

dbyings nas = thugs dam rgyud = hūm̐/ nub phyogs klu rgyal nyi zla pad steng du// sde dpon rta mgrin pad+ma gzi ldan 'khril// rigs bzhi yab yum phra men zil gnon brgyad// yum bcas sgo bzhi khyi spyang khaṃ rgya drug/ dmus long bzhi dang mche mchog ngur 'brug bzhi// dgu bcu rtsa brgyad = dbyings nas = thugs dam rgyud = hūm̐/ byang phyogs lha chen pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// 297) dpal len rdo rje gzhon nu rgyas 'debs 'khril/ /rigs bzhi yab yumakhro bcu yum dang bcas// za gsod sgo ba phur bsrung bcu gnyis dang*// bse lcags dung gi skyes bu pho nya'i tshogs// bdun cu rtsa bzhi rgyal = dbyings nas = thugs dam rgyud bskul = hūm̐/ shar lhor ma mo pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// dpal chen bla med he ru mu kha 'khril// rtag rgyal ma lnga srid 'gro bde 'gro dang*/ ye shes rje mo sman mo sgo ma bzhi// sbas pa'i ma bzhi la sogs pho nya'i tshogs// bdun cu rtsa dgu dbang thugs dam can// dbyings nas = thugs dam rgyud = hūm̐/ lho nub dar zab nyi zla pad steng du// rig 'dzin slob dpon rdo rje rnal 'byor 'khril// sras mchog rigs bzhi bka' brgyad rig 'dzin dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mo sgo skyong bzhi la sogs// rig 'dzin slob dpon yongs rdzogs lha tshogs ni// nyi shu rtsa drug rgyal = dbyings nas = 298) thugs dam rgyud = hūm̐/ nub byang lha chen nyi zla pad steng du// dpal len dregs pa kun 'dul spyi 'dul 'khril// rigs bzhi yab yum sde dpon sum cu dang*// dregs pa sde brgyad sgo skyong bzhi la sogs// 'jig rten mchod bstod yongs rdzogs lha tshogs ni// sum cu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba = dbyings nas = thugs dam rgyud bskul = hūm̐/ byang shar dgra bgegs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// sde dpon stobs stobs bcu bdag mos 'khril// rigs bzhi yab yum sngags bdag bco brgyad dang*// pho nya dam can sgo skyong la sogs te// drag po sngags kyi lha tshogs dmod pa'ilalabadag

/nyi shu rtsa brgyad rgyal = dbyings nas thugs dam rgyud = hūm̐/ dpal gyi thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya ni// ye shesakhyung chen gzugs skur ston mdzad cing*// log 'dren dgra bgegs ma lus bsgril ba dang*// bsgo ba nyan cing mi mthun phyogs rnams 'dul// gzhal yas bar la'akhyam dang ni sgo bzhi na// dpa' bo dpa' mo 299) yab yum zung bzhi dang*// mkha' 'gro so gnyis dbang mo nyi shu brgyad// ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma brgyad rnams dang*// ging chen bco brgyad sgo ba yab yum brgyad// brgya dang rtsa brgyad bar 'khyam lha tshogs rnams// dbyings nas = thugs dam rgyud = hūm̐/ phyi rol lcags ri 'khor yug la gnas pa// sa bdag so gnyis laṅka bcu drug dang*/ pho nya drug cu rigs 'dus ḍak+ki brgyad// bstan ma bcu gnyis la sogs brgya po gnyis// dpal gyi bka' nyan 'khor yug skyong mdzad pa'i// bka' sdod dam can yongs rdzogs thugs dam can// dbyings nas = thugs dam rgyud = hūm̐/ zhi khro'i lha tshogs bzhi brgya so drug la// ye shes lha ni nyis brgya so brgyad de// chos dgu'i pho nya brgya dang go dgu sogs// las byed bar 'khyams skyong skyong mdzad brgya bcu drug /lcags ri skyong ba brgyad dang sum cu ste// bdun brgya nyer 300) lnga rgyal ba thugs dam can// dbyings nas sku bskyod dam rdzas mchod gtor bzhes// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces bskul lo/ lnga pa gtor skyong bya ba la sngon gyi dam tshig gnyan po'i mtha' thig le chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ gtor zlog chen mo ska la ni chad mdo gtor ma 'phang sar slebs nas byed par phyag srol dang*/ de ltar ma yin pa'i tshe yang gtor ma rnams dkyil 'khor las phyir dpags te rtsog rtse lta bu'i khar bzhag nas sman rag sbreng zhing*/ de yang chad mdo'i dgos ched ni/ da lta 'o skol sgrub pa po rnams lta dgongs ting 'dzin gyi nus pa dman pas srung ma las la bkol nus pa'i gdengs dang mi ldan yang*/

sngon gyi rgyal ba rig 'dzin rnams kyis bka' dang dam tshig gi gnyer phogs tshul gyi dran gso lta bur bgyid pas khong rnams phrin las mi sgrub pa'i rang dbang med par 'gyur ba yin phyir chad mdo 'di ltar bsgrag par bya'o/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa dang po la// 'og min dga' ldan 301) gnas mchog dam pa ru// bcom ldan dpal chen khrag 'thung rgyal po yis// snang srid ma mo dam la btags pa'i tshe// ko'u ri la sogs gnas kyi ma mo brgyad// singha la sogs yul gyi phra men brgyad// rta gdong la sogs ye shes sgo ma bzhi// so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang*// bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam// rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma = rgyu sbyor bar chad bsal bar ma = brnag pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral bar ma = bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam/ /sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar// sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// de 'og bar gyi bskal pa dbus ma la// bal yul yang le shod kyi dben gnas su// slob dpon chen po pad+ma 302) 'byung gnas dang*// slob ma mkhas pa bi ma mi dra yi/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyed tshe// rdo rje rigs kyi srung ma yongs 'dus nas// so so'i gzugs = bka' yi = sangs rgyas = rnal 'byor tshe = rgyu sbyor bar chad = brnag pa'i dgra bgegs = bcol ba'i = sngon tshe zhal = sha khrag brgyan = thugs dam rgyud bskul= de 'og bskal ba dus kyi tha ma la// bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag tu// slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*// slob ma'i dngas ma rje 'bangs grogs bcas kyis// zhi khro yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor zhal phyed tshe// sgrub pa bka' brgyad dam can yongs 'dus nas// so so'i gzugs =

bka' yi = sangs rgyas = rnal 'byor tshe = rgyu sbyor = brnag pa'i = bcol ba'i= sngon tshe = sha khrag = thugs dam = de 'og lnga rgya dus kyi mtha' ma la// dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su// slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng dang*// thugs rje chen po'i chos dbang gis// gsang ba sgrub chen dkyil 'khor zhal 303) phyed tshe// dregs pa'i sde dpon chen po sum cu yis// soso'i gzugs = bka yi = sangs rgyas = rnal 'byor tshe = rgyu sbyor = brnag pa'i = bcol ba'i = sngon tshe = sha khrag= thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces pa'i chad mdo bsgrag nas gtor ma 'bul ba'i dus yin na phyi rol gtsang zhing mtho ba'i sar dngos grub phyir mi yal ba'i rten 'brel gyi gtor kha nang du bstan nas phul la bzhag cing bshal chus brtan skyong bya'o/ gtor 'phang ba'i dus yin na/ drug pa gtor zor ni/ de yan chad thams cad gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dod yon phu+un sum tshogs pa'i dngos por 'du shes par bya ba yin kyang*/ 'di nas gtor ma drag po'i mtshon cha thog gi char pa nad kyi na bun dug gi 'tshub ma me'i phung po khro chung gi tsha tsha la sogs 'jigs pa'i sprul pa sna tshogs par gyur nas/ bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs kyi snod bcud yul mkhar mi nor dang bcas pa rdul du rlog pa'i nus ldan du gyur par dmigs shing*/ srung ma dam can pho nya 304) las byed kyi tshogs rnams dmigs bya'i yul du dmag dpung la 'chas par bsam la/ gser skyems phul nas gzug cing gtor zor 'phang ba ni/ hūm̐/ ma nyes dpang du dkon mchog bzhugs// dgra bgegs ma gtogs sku gzur cig /bka' brgyad lha tshogs dmag dpung 'gyed// dgra bgegs snying la gtor zor rgyob// badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān tig+nan/ e hur thuṃ dzaḥ dgra bgegs nṛ ti shatruṃ mā ra ya rbad/ ces pas lagator ma 'phang zhing drag sngags dmod pa sna tshogs brjod cing thal mo brdab la ting 'dzin gyis gzir ro/

bdun pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ gtor gzhong rnams 'gug cing mchod de dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ ho/ de yan chad du dpal chen po'i pha phog ma gtogs par phyin na yang*/ nag mo bzhin mi sdug gi bu mo bdud mo chen mo bzhi dang*/ dmar mo khro gnyer 305) can gyi bu mo gnod sbyin mo chen mo bzhi dang*/ dkar mo mdangs ldan ma'i bu mo sman btsun chen mo bzhi la sogs pa bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor rdul rnyed dang bcas pa thams cad sngon gyi thugs dam dang dam tshig las ma g.yel bar bstan pa bsrung ba dang sgrub pa po'i gdong grog la skad cig yud tsam thang cig gis gshegs shig e a ra li ho/ hriṃ hriṃ dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho/ badz+ra ḍāk+ki ni hūm̐ dzaḥ bh+yo/ bstan ma skyong mdzad ma dang sring*// dpal gnas ma dang yang dag gshegs// khyung btsun kong lha g.yu bun ma/ /me stag zla 'od byang rgyal ma// gser thang kun bzang shan+ting dpal// klu mo gzi 'bar la sogs pa'i// bstan ma bcu gnyis gtor ma longs// mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs rnams bzlog ma ma hring*/ ma ma 306) hriṃ/ bstan skyong chen mo khyed rnams kyang*// sngon tshe sngon gyi dus tsa na// slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis// a su ra yi brag phug tu// zhing chen mchog gi bcal bkram nas// lag tu rdo rje byin nas kyang*// rdo rje 'chang gi gral du bzhag /thar pa thob par ming yang btags// ma tshogs khyed kyis dam bcas pa// rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i grogs bya'o zhes// nad yaṃ thams cad zhi ba dang*// dgra bgegs thams cad sgrol ba dang*// bsam pa thams cad sgrub po ces// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin// dam tshig de las khyed ma 'da'// dam tshig de las 'das gyur na// badz+ra yak+sha drag po yis// snying gi dkyil nas khrag phyungs te// de bas thugs dam cher dgongs la// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzad// ces bshal chu nam mkhar 'thor zhing*/

badz+ra a mṛ ta khā hi/ ya hi gats+tsha/ zhes pas rang rang gi gnas su bshegs gsol bya'o/ ༈ brgyad pa gtor gzhong gi 'og tu dam sri mnan pa'i las bzhi'i bro ni/ 307) lam rgya bram mam/ sgo khang gi 'og lta bur gtor gzhong gang yod rnams ba spubs pa'i 'og tu e gru gsum 'jigs su rung ba dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi 'og tu thug pa'i gting na/ dam sri 'byung po'i rigs thams cad bkug nas bcug pa'i kha rdo rje ri rab kyi mnan pa'i steng du bdag nyid he ru ka'i 'khor du rigs bzhi'i he ru las bzhi mdog can phrin las bzhi'i phur pa bsnams pa grangs med pas bskor te khro bo'i rta bro brdung bar dmigs shing*/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang rgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi = chos kyi = dge 'dun gyi = yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i bden pa chen po'i stobs kyis/ bstan pa la gnod cing sems can la 'tshe bar byed pa dang dam pa'i chos zab mo sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i gnod byed dam sri 'byung po'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad skad cig tsam la gtor gzhong ri rab chen po'i 'og tu khug cig tri yam̐ 308) kaṃ pa ri aṃ ku sha dzaḥ

zhes bkug la/ de nas sgrub pa po rnams g.yas g.yon srin lag lu gu rgyud du sbrel nas bro zlum po/ gru bzhi/ gru gsum gyi bskor ba'i dkyil du rdo rje slob dpon gyi khro bo'i stangs stabs 'gying gar gyi gtor gzhong zhabs kyis tshul dang bcas pas dbyangs kyi nga ros bro brdung ste/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las rdzogs pa'i dpal// gti mug bud+dha rdo rje la// zhi ba'i lha dang lha mos bskor// dngul lam dkar po'i shing dag la// mgo bo brgya mdud rtse zlum po// ngos la zhi ba'i lha bkod de/ /btab pas 'jigs brgyad zhi bar 'gyur// zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med// zhi mdzad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ oṃ oṃ mi mthun phyogs rnams shan+ting ku ru ye swā hā/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las rdzogs pa'i dpal// nga rgyal rin chen rdo rje la// rgyas pa'i lha dang = gser ram ser po'i shing = mgo bo brgya mdud rtse gru bzhi// 309) ngos la rgyas pa'i lha bkod de// btab pas 'byor drug rgyas par 'gyur// rgyas par ma = rgyas mdzad lha la = swā swā swā/ tshe dang bsod nams puṣ+ṭing ku ru ye swā hā/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun = yon tan phrinalas = 'dod chags pad+ma rdo rje la// dbang gi lha = zangs sam dmar po'i = mgo bo brgya mdud rtse zla gam// ngos la dbang gi = btab pas snang srid dbang du 'gyur// dbang du ma gyur = dbang mdzad lha la = hrī hrī hrī/ lha 'dre mi gsum wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas = yon tan phrag dog karma rdo rje la// drag po'i lha dang lha mos bskor// lcags sam nag po'i shing dag la// mgo bo brgya mdud rtse zur gsum// ngos la drag po'i lha = btab pas dgra bgegs rlag par 'gyur// rlag par mi 'gyur gang yang med// rlag mdzad lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// hā hā hā/

gnod byed dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭaḥ ces phrin las bzhi'i bro brdung ba'i rjes su/ gtor gzhong rnams kha 310) yar phyes pa tsam gyi/ rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yon mchod rnams kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor mtha' dag yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur/ zhes mos la nang du log go ༈ dgu pa bskyed rim nyid rdzogs rim gyi dbyings su bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐/ dang po chos sku skye med ngang nyid las// 'gro don skye ba'i cho 'phrul tshom bu dgu zhi khro yongs rdzogs 'gro ba kun btul nas// slar yang chos dbyings rnam dag klong du bsdu/ oṃ ā hūm̐ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pa tsam gyis/ bdag nyid kyi sprul pa las kyi he ru ka de nyid bdag gtso bo la tshur thim gtso mchog gi zhal nas hūm̐ zhes gsungs ma thag phyi rol snod bcud brtan g.yo'i dngos po mtha' dag 'od du zhu bas 'od mthing ga'i rang bzhin du gyur pa gzhal yas khang la thim zhing*/ gzhal yas khang 'khor gyi lha tshogs la thim/ 'khor yangagatso mchog la thim/ gtso bo nyid kyang rim pas yas man rnams thugs srog hūm̐ la 'dus te hūm̐ yang mas rim bzhin gyen rdzogs su thig le nā da la 'dus pa'i mthar 'ja' sprin 311) nam mkhar yal ba bzhin gyur ba'i ngang nas/ 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi 'dzin rtog gang gis kyang ma bslad pa'i gnas lugs gdod ma'i ye shes khyab gdal chen por mnyam par gzhag bya dang 'jog byed dang bral bar glod pa ni kun bzang che mchog he ru ka'i ting 'dzin yang dag pa'i snying po'o/ bcu pa cho ga'i lhag chad bskang ba ni/ sku bskyed rim ma gsal ba dang bsgom tshul ma shes pa/ brda don rtags gsum rgyud la ma 'byor pa la sogs kyi nyes skyon thams cad kā li thabs kyi yi ges bskang ste/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kaṣaḥ gsung bzlas brjod sngags kyi sgra ma dag pa/ grangs ma tshang ba/

go rim ma shes pa la sogs kyi nyes skyon thams cad shes rab ā lis bskang ste/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ ā/ thugs ting 'dzin 'phro 'du'i rim pa nor 'khrul 'gal nyes ci mchis pa thams cad zhi khro kun 'dus kyi snying po 312) rdo rje sems dpa'i ye ge brgya pas bskang ste/ ā+oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa te no pa tiṣ+ṭa dṛ ḍhi me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me prats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shrī yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga to badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+ri bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ de ltar sngags rnams tshar gsum sogs brjod cing*/ don dam par ni nyes sgrib gsag bya gsog byed dang bskang bya skong byed kyi chos thams cad kyang chos dbyings spros bral chen po las gzhan mi dmigs so/ bcu gcig pa chad mtha' bsal phyir slar yang lhar ldang zhing sprul pa sgyu ma'i tshul gyis 'gro don rgyun du spyod pa'i go cha bgo ba dang smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar ba ni/ chos dbyings stong pa nyid de'i ngang nas skad cig gis gsal gdangs 'gag med chu bur rdol ba ltar/ rang nyid dpal chen he ru ka mthing nag rdo rje thod phrag bsnams shing khro chas thams cad rdzogs pa ye shes kyi me spungs 'bar 313) ba'i klong na 'gyings pa'i tshul du lam gyi gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros nas snod bcud thams cad la phog pa'i mthus/ snod bcud kyi 'jig rten thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi skye 'gro mtha' dag he ru ka kho na'i ngo bor gyur te/ snang tshad sku/ grags tshad gsung*/ dran rtog mtha' dag chos nyid rol pa chen po 'ba' shig tu rig cing rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas bya spyod thams cad mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don du dmigs shing*/

hūm̐/ ngar 'dzin rnam dag sgyu lus 'ja' 'dra 'di// dpal chen sku gsung thugs kyi rgyas btab ste// bden pa dbyer med lta spyod zung 'brel bas// rgyun du 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam bya'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra hriṃ/ zhes dam bca' zhing*/ dge ba zad cing gong du 'phel phyir bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas gdab pa 'di yang bya ste/ ho/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis mthu byin gyis// bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kun// zhi 314) rgyas dbang drag phrin las mnga' brnyes shing*// sku gsung lhun grub 'gro don mthar phyin shog /de nas mjug gi mtha' rgyan du bkra shis bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod cing rten 'brel gyi snying po bzlas pa'i me tog gi char dbab cing dbyangs dang bcas pas/ khyab bdag kun tu bzang dang rdo rje sems// dga' rab shrī sing yu rgyan yab yum dang*// chos kyi dbang phyug yab sras rgyud par bcas// rtsa rgyud bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog chos sku mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po'i klong*// longs sku rigs lnga sku lnga ye shes lnga*/ sprul sku sna tshogs 'gro don yid bzhin gter// bder bshegs zhi ba'i lha tshogs = chos dbyings rnam dag ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bor skur bstan gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka yi = sku mchog 'gyur ba med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// 'jam dpal gshin rje snang srid sku 315) yi dpal// 'gyur med don gyi ye nas lhun grub pa'i// gshin rje yongs rdzogs sku yi bkra shis shog gsung mchog 'gag pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// dbang chen rta mgrin chos sgo 'dus pa'i dpal// 'gag med don ni ye nas lhun grub pa'i/ /yang dag yongs rdzogs thugs kyi = yon tan mi zad gter gyi dkyil 'khor nas// che mchog he ru ka yon tan rdzogs pa'i dpal// yon tan don ni ye nas lhun grub pa'i// bdud rtsi yon tan yongs rdzogs =

phrin las thogs pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// rdo rje gzhon nu mthu stobs rdzogs pa'i dpal// phrin las don ni ye nas lhun grub pa'i// phur pa phrin las 316) yongs rdzogs = gzi brjid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// bla med he ru ka ma mo 'dus pa'i dpal// skye 'gag gnyis med don ni lhun grub pa'i// ma tshogs las la 'khol ba'i = byin rlabs yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// rig 'dzin gtso mchog rgyud lung man ngag dpal// sa lam yon tan rang bzhin lhun grub pa'i// shes rab rnam gsum mnga' brnyes = drag rtsal me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// dregs pa kun 'dul bdud dpung 'joms pa'i dpal// mthu rtsal rmad byung sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung*// sde brgyad bran du 'khol ba'i = dgra bgegs gdug pa tshar gcod dkyil 'khor nas// stobs ldan nag po snang srid srog bdag dpal// drag sngags dmod pas ma rungs log lta sgrol// nus mthu yongs su rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog bka' dang dam la gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// dam ldan 317) skyongs shing dam nyams rdul du rlog rnam bzhi'i phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal// bka' sdod yongs rdzogs srung ma'i bkra shis shog /thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin bla ma mchog /dngos grub kun stsol yi dam yongs rdzogs lha// bar chad sel mdzad mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog / ces sogs shis brjod rgyas par bya'o/ de nas bla ma'i gtor ma dang bdud rtsi sman sogs dngos grub tu len par 'os pa'i rdzas rnams dngos grub tu blangs shing*/ gzhan mchod rdzas yo byad sogs bsdu bar 'os pa rnams gshegs bsdu bya tshul mjug gi bya ba mtha' dag spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ 'di la gang zag la la'i bsam yul du rgyud sde 'og ma dag gi 'gros dang bstun na ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs tshul mi 'dug pas ci zhig snyam du sems pa 'byung srid 'di ni gsang sngags bla med rgyud sde gong ma'i lugs kyis dam ye dbyer med du bsres tshar nas slar gshegs

318) gsol bya mi dgos par chos nyid thig le nyag gcig chen por bsdu ba ni khyad par 'phags pa'i skabs don yin no/ de ltar de yan chad kyis zhi khro bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs chen po'i las byang gzhung srong gi rim pa gu ru rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid kyis mdzad nas rje 'bangs grogs gsum la zab par gdams pa chos dbang gi gter byon sor bzhag dang*/ sa bcad kyi go rim kyang rtsa tho nyid ji lta ba las gzhan pa'i bcos bslad kyi dri ma med par bstan zin to/ de yang spyir gang zag gi bsam pa'i bye brag tha dad sna tshogs pa'i dbang gis/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur gter byon gyi las gzhung sogs la/ la las ha cang rgyas nas nyog 'dug ces zer nas 'phri ba dang*/ la las bsdus pas ma tshang 'dug ces gzhan nas 'gebs pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig gsang sngags gsar ma'i chog gzhung gi 'gros dang bstun nas bcos bsgyur na tshogs byed pa snang yang*/ 'khor 'das dus gsum ma lus sgrib med du gzigs pa'i rgyal mchog pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis ma mkhyen mi dgongs pa gcig dus nam du'ang srid pa ma yin tshe/ de'i bka' gzhung lhad med dri bral 319) nyid lag tu blangs shing nyams su lon na byin rlabs kyi 'jug tshul bslu ba med pa chos nyid yin pas na/ zab mo'i chos la rang bzo'i dri mas ma bslad pa shin tu gal che ba'i tshul yang phyis 'byung gi gang zag rnams kyis shes par bya'o/ ༈ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams mtha' yas kun// zhi khro bka' brgyad snying por ma 'dus med// 'di bsgrub rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus kyi// thugs srog snying po'i dngos grub bde blag grub// dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi sgrub zab mo la// gang gis rtse gcig gus pas mchod dang bsgrub// de la rgyal ba rnams kyis byin rlobs shing*// rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yun du dgongs// bka' sdod dam can rnams kyang rje bor gyur// ma rungs 'byung po 'dug pa'i gnyen por che// mchog dngos bgegs med tshe gcig thob 'gyur na// thun mong phrin las bzhi sogs smos ci dgos// de phyir gsang ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhung*// 'di ni rgyal dbang pad+ma'i bka' zol med// chos kyi dbang phyug zab gter yang bcud de// rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i thugs dam snying po'o//

༈ de lta bu'i gsang sngags snying po sgrub pa bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs chen po'i phrin las 320) gzhung srong gi rim pa 'di nyid kyi ngag 'don gyi tshig rnams gter gzhung sor bzhag dang*/ cung zad tsam kha skong lhan thabs med mi rung gi rigs dag kyang bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs nyid kyi yig cha las phyung ba kho na ma gtogs gzhan dang ma 'dres pa dang*/ sa bcad so so'i skabs don bsgom bya'i dmigs rim rnams mdo tsam ma bstan na/ ding sang gi chos pa spyi dang khyad par gsang sngags par rlom pa phal mo ches cho ga ting 'dzin dang ma ldan par bro pa glu gra bsgrigs pa ltar mdangs dbyangs dang rol mo'i sgra tsam 'ba' shig don du gnyer ba cho ga'i gzugs brnyan gyis 'tsho ba sha stag mthong bas/ de 'dra bas don 'grub pa ma yin tshe/ bskal bzang don la brten pa'i skyes mchog dag la phan par bsam nas/ bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi bskyed rdzogs gsum gyi gzhung 'brel sgom khog sogs las ji ltar byung ba lhad med 'gag bsdus go bder bkod pa las/ mi shes shes brju'i spyi brtol gyis gzu lum ras chod du byas pa ma yin la/ 'di lta bu yi ge'i lam du 'khod nas sgrub pa po mchog dman bar ma thams cad kyi tshig don lag tu 321) blag bde ba zhig kyang gyis shig ces/ mdo khams shar phyogs nas gsang sngags snying po'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong bsrung spel gyi mnga' bdag dam par gyur pa mi yi mgon/ lha'i rje gdul bya'i sde dpon/ mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa la dbang 'byor ba mtshungs bral chos kyi rje ngag dbang bstan skyong dpal bzang po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes bka'i bskul ba yang dag pa gser gyi me tog dang bcas pa stsal ba nyid lhag bsam bzang po'i thod du bcings te yi ger bsgrigs chags su bkod pa 'di ni/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi la mos pa lam du byed pa'i btsun pa mkhas mchog pad+ma legs grub rtsal gyis/

chu klang pakaṣu g.yas su 'khyil ba'i ngogs kyi ri bo'i spo bsam gtan dang rnam par grol ba la mngon par sbyor ba'i dben khang gser gyi rgyal mtshan can du yig lam du bkod pa 'dis mtshon tshe rabs kun gyi legs byas ma lus gcig tu bzlums pa'i mthu 'bras kyis/ phyogs bcu rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can rnams 322) mi gnas pa'i myang 'das chen po la 'khod par gyur cig ma sdu sarba dza ga twaṃ/
